TEXT.English: Abashi the Black Dragon - 黑龙阿巴什[PARAGRAPH:2]Only 4 days. 4 days without sleep, of constant battle. I would have laid down and died for the chance to just rest for a few seconds, but there was no rest here. Every defeated soldier was raised as another member of the undead horde. Within minutes of their corpse hitting the cursed land their arms were twitching again with an unholy life, then they would reach for their weapon and we, who fought and bled beside them as brothers, would be forced to kill them.[PARAGRAPH:1]We had come through the Aduro Straight, where angels and demons battled across bleeding lands and had thought the worst was past when they came through to the calm Meditor Sea. Our fleet of white sails and cheering men, an army of many nations landed as one on the shores of this island. Was that really only 4 short days ago? How I wished for the days spent in that hell, they are fond memories compared to this land.[PARAGRAPH:1]The paladins are our inspiration. They fight tirelessly, never questioning, fighting for every inch of ground as if it was any different than the cracked earth we just came from. Even now Vaghan stands surrounded, his armor gleams even on this moonless night and the power of the Empyrean flows through him.[PARAGRAPH:1]An Ash Bearer comes at me, using his sword to thrust rather than slash. If he was to dismember me I would be weaker when raised as an undead. I parry the clumsy attack but he continues on, throwing his shoulder into me and pushing me back. I stumble into Vaghan and realize this is the Ash Bearers real intent, that he could use me to distract the paladin, to make him vulnerable if only for a second.[PARAGRAPH:1]I fall out of the way, trying to keep from interfering with Vaghan's fight even if I am sacrificed in doing so. The Ash Bearer comes quickly upon me but is stopped when Vaghan steps over me and slashes through him. I have a brief glimpse of those Vaghan was fighting with, a wraith and a juggernaught of sewn corpses setting upon his now exposed back. Vaghan seems to ignore them, thrusting his arm up there is a flash and a ring of blinding light explodes from him. The wraith is destroyed, the juggernaught reels backwards and is hacked apart by our men.[PARAGRAPH:1]Vaghan grabs me and pulls me to my feet, "Do not despair, hope yet remains."[PARAGRAPH:1]Then he is gone. There is only a slight whistle to indicate that anything passed through the night until it turns back towards the army. A dragon of sleek black scales is silhouetted briefly against the sky, darker even than the night like a hole in sackcloth. The dragon spits out Vaghan's remains, a small rain of blood and once perfect holy vestments. Then she roars and I find myself suddenly nostalgic for the days of constant battle.[PARAGRAPH:2]- Visions from the Pool of Tears and revelation that the Sheaim had awoken Abashi and was using her in the Battle of the Black Tower

TEXT.English: 这位塞安英雄能够喷吐烈焰，她的咆哮会令周遭的敌方单位陷入恐惧。她还免疫魔法，较弱的单位往往会因过于畏惧而不敢攻击她。
TEXT.Chinese: 这位塞安英雄能够喷吐烈焰，她的咆哮会令周遭的敌方单位陷入恐惧。她还免疫魔法，较弱的单位往往会因过于畏惧而不敢攻击她。

TEXT.English: Acheron the Red Dragon - 红龙阿切隆[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 在这个地方，时光仿佛毫无耐心，飞逝而过。在无尽的虚空中，曾经的神话消失了，但不会被遗忘。埃瑞布斯不会那么快遗忘红龙阿切隆，那个火焰领主、毁灭之兽。当它迈步于大地之上，坚实的高山都会为之颤抖；当它翱翔在天空之中，远古的杉树也会被连根拔起。当它击败敌人之后，相比之下敌人的弱小让它们显得仿佛从未存在。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 但是契约，它让维持红龙的力量消失。它依然如此令人恐惧，然而它的伤口愈合不再迅速。现在当它喷出自己的火焰的时候，自己也饱受痛苦。在一场决定命运的战斗中，阿切隆失败了，从此一蹶不振。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 阿切隆不可能像其他人一样就此平静的安息，满足于成为传说中的君王。这，不是它的天性。它的天性只有用火来诠释。火贪婪的吞噬着，随风张狂的舞着，当火被扑灭的时候它可能会暂时偃旗息鼓，但是它永远渴望从微弱的火种中再度重燃。后来，红龙嗅到了它女主人巴尔的气息。那并不是巴尔女神本身，而是一些拥有着和她也是阿切隆它自己相近的燃烧般的天性的人们。他们繁殖成长的如此迅速，吼叫着战斗，狂怒中死亡。他们混乱，但是受到严格的秩序的支配。他们暴力，但是鼓励新生。他们敏捷，但是身上有不灭的印迹。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 他们并不知道他们对红龙发出的呼喊给予它力量，但他们的确那么做了。他们的野性敞开了大门，让红龙的实体从腐朽已久的骨肉中重生。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 在安海普特，三牙的背包掉了下来。包裹中跌落出来的是三具人类的头骨，一把铁质的小刀，还有一大把闪闪发亮的小饰品。半边鼻准备去捡一个钻石戒指，三牙二话不说扑向了他，两个兽人在地上撕缠扭打，而近旁的哥布林一边欢呼，一边偷偷的把三牙的战利品据为己有。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 他们的缠斗被一声振天喊地的吼叫打断。所有人转过脸来。带着往日的荣耀，红龙阿切隆再度降临。它的皮肤绽放着红宝石般的光泽，它呼吸的时候，翻滚的火焰云照亮了黯淡的黄昏。它的每一个牙齿和爪子都如此闪亮，尖利，完美，仿佛它从未经历过那无数的战斗。它的双翼遮蔽了卑微的村庄，发出恐怖怒吼，其实相比于它的其他更令人恐惧的表情，这只不过是一个微笑。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 兽人和哥布林收集好他们的战利品将它们送到这个无比强大的龙的脚下。很快这些战利品堆成了山，也见证了一个传奇的再临。

TEXT.English: Adept - 术士[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 那些在魔法学校学习的有抱负的青年在毕业时会接受一系列严格的考试。那些通过考试的幸运儿可以成为受过完整教育的魔法师的学徒和助手，开始学习一些初级的魔法。不幸的是，在很多方面术士不过是法师里面的炮灰。他们只具有学徒的能力，却奉命去做最危险的工作。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 术士是成为魔法世界领袖的第一步，可以选择学习任何魔法课程。当他们的技能和实力日臻完美时，被迫做出一个选择:是做一个实用的召唤者，还是继续钻研魔法的奥义。二者都是十分强大的，这是术士们不得不做出的一个个人选择。

TEXT.English: 术士升级时可以学习各种魔法，这样可以让他们使用更多的技能。他们不用战斗也有机会得到经验值。
TEXT.Chinese: 术士升级时可以学习各种魔法，这样可以让他们使用更多的技能。他们不用战斗也有机会得到经验值。

TEXT.English: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]冒险者[COLOR_REVERT]是一个特殊的英雄单位，他们可以升级为任何一种目前可以建造的肉搏、弓箭、骑兵、侦查和法术单位。他们每回合可以获得一点经验，因此他们可以很快成长起来。
TEXT.Chinese: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]冒险者[COLOR_REVERT]是一个特殊的英雄单位，他们可以升级为任何一种目前可以建造的肉搏、弓箭、骑兵、侦查和法术单位。他们每回合可以获得一点经验，因此他们可以很快成长起来。

TEXT.English: 风元素作为三阶召唤物虽然孱弱，却能越过任何地形，包括水域地块，且视野比其他单位远 2 格。赢得战斗后，风元素会召唤出 [LINK=UNIT_LIGHTNING_ELEMENTAL]光元素[\LINK]。
TEXT.Chinese: 风元素作为三阶召唤物虽然孱弱，却能越过任何地形，包括水域地块，且视野比其他单位远 2 格。赢得战斗后，风元素会召唤出 [LINK=UNIT_LIGHTNING_ELEMENTAL]光元素[\LINK]。

TEXT.English: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]飞艇[COLOR_REVERT]允许库里奥塔特运送士兵，尤其是当库里奥塔特没有海滨城市，但他们却需要运送部队的时候。
TEXT.Chinese: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]飞艇[COLOR_REVERT]允许库里奥塔特运送士兵，尤其是当库里奥塔特没有海滨城市，但他们却需要运送部队的时候。

TEXT.English: Alazkan the Assassin - 刺客阿拉兹干[PARAGRAPH:2]The Luchuirp sculptor carefully chipped through the stone. Alazkan didn't believe the dwarf could damage the treasure inside the statue but he wasn't taking any chances. If the statue had to be broken apart, he would find the most talented to do it.[PARAGRAPH:1]The dwarf blew loose marble away from where he was chiseling, then looked at Alazkan in surprise. A polished piece of jet black could be seen within the white stone.[PARAGRAPH:1]"That's it," Alazkan said, "be careful."[PARAGRAPH:1]To further make his point Alazkan pushed the point of his sword into dwarfs back. It cut easily through the thick leather and made a shallow cut in the sculptors shoulder. The dwarf gasped in pain but continued working carefully to remove the black piece from the statue without damaging it.[PARAGRAPH:1]When he was done a jagged shard of black was revealed. It looked like an opal but flat and about the size of small buckler. On one side it was smooth and so black it looked like a hole in whatever it was laid upon. The other side was polished and reflected Alazkan's image...[PARAGRAPH:1]The sculptor ran for the door. Alazkan looked up only to see a ghostly image of himself burst across the room and then hobble the dwarf with a strike to the back of his knees. The dwarf fell and Alazkan watched his image jump onto him, stab again and the dwarf was dead.[PARAGRAPH:1]In a few seconds the image disappeared. Alazkan wrapped the black shard into his cloak, this would be very handy indeed. Then a Svartalfar hunter Alazkan had assigned to keep guard opened the door.[PARAGRAPH:1]"They are coming" she said.[PARAGRAPH:1]"Good," Alazkan replied, "we are done here."[PARAGRAPH:1]The Luchuirp moved slowly through the forest. A small punitive expedition responding to the sculptors message. They were too late, but it didn't matter, they'd soon regret trying to make retribution upon the servants of the Winter Court. They traveled like elephants, crashing along the path, making a great ruckus, trampling the brush and plants on the lightly worn path into the dust. Alazkan crouched among his sisters, his fellow warriors, and waited for them to come.[PARAGRAPH:1]In a roomy, well-furnished and comfortable tent, far away from the dark and miserable forest the soldiers were slogging through, the Luchuirp commanders gathered around a mage with a scrying glass, listening to his report of their progress. The tent and all the ones around it were set up in a clearing, which was hacked and burned out of the all-encroaching forests that covered and obscured the lands of Faeryl Vinconia, the Queen of Mischief. The generals didn't put themselves in harm's way, they had to be detached from their little army in order to make cool, correct decisions unhindered by the chaos of a surrounding skirmish. But right now, nothing demanded their attention, so they discussed what they would do when the soldiers reached the closest settlement.[PARAGRAPH:1]On a stretch where the path narrowed slightly and the shadows seemed to deepen, the Svartalfar struck. Banshees, witches, amazons, lashing out from the darkness, retreating, and lashing out again, cutting short a man's life every time. Jinxes, curses, knives, darts, arrows and all manner of projectiles flying out between the shadows and the foliage, leaving pain and terror in their wake. Poisoned men raved like lunatics, the wounded screamed and the soldiers yelled and cried in confusion. Alazkan danced and flitted among the confused mass of soldiers. A thrust here, a slash there, with the grace and efficiency of endless practice. Crossbowmen fired bolts blindly, hoping to hit something in the trees, but as often as not hitting their allies, fighting vicious hand-to-hand battles with the Svartalfar in an attempt to strike back at their hidden tormentors. Those who broke and fled along the path were caught in hidden traps, just as lethal as their live foes. The battle was going badly for the Luchuirp, it was going worse than badly, it was disastrous. If it weren't for the fact that they were trapped, it would have been a rout. As it was, ever dwindling pockets of desperate survivors were doing their best to take as many elvish vixens with them as possible before their inevitable demise, fighting with the rage and bitterness of desperate men. Then the spells came.[PARAGRAPH:1]Action among the greying men in the elaborate tent had been swift and decisive. The battle was lost, the men dead anyway. What difference did it make who killed them in the final reckoning? They may as well use the opportunity to strike a blow at their shadowy foes. At least then the soldiers would not have died entirely in vain. The general, a hard man in glittering, polished armor with little practical use, had not hesitated in ordering the mages to saturate the battlefield with their ethereal doom.[PARAGRAPH:1]The fire rained down from the sky, meteors, lightning and fireballs splitting the trees and sending flaming splinters and shards flying between the combatants. Great chunks of earth flew up where meteors struck and heat waves threw bodies around like rag dolls or vaporized unfortunates where they stood. The forest floor was turned to mud, a mud made not of water and dirt, but of blood, and sap, and earth and ash. A cratered wasteland, every bit as hellish as the lands of the Infernal, where elves and dwarves lay, sliced and burned, united in undignified, violent death, a horrific, ever convulsing monument to hatred, composed of limbs, flames and entrails.[PARAGRAPH:1]The scene was pure chaos, the horrible banshee wails of mangled Svartalfar mixing with the despairing, incomprehensible cries of the dwarves that were being sacrificed by their comrades in arms. Survivors sought any cover they could find, skittering desperately away from the destruction. When two foes found the same hole to hide in, a brief fight would erupt, leaving only the victor to cower in safety until another challenger arrived. The air reeked with the odor of the freshly slaughtered, mingled with smoke, earth and the odd smell of magic left behind. And all the while the spells thundered down, pummeling the site again, and again, and again.[PARAGRAPH:1]The men in the tent listened impassively or paced around the tent as the mage conveyed his impressions from the battle. The crackles and fizzes of the mages working their craft could be clearly heard through the thin walls, as could the duller, more distant whooshes and booms of the spells hitting home. Surely, no one could survive such destruction? A great blow was struck this day, a blow which those accursed elves would not soon forget. The generals congratulated each other. Still, they were suitably somber about losing so many brave, but sadly expendable, warriors.[PARAGRAPH:1]Alazkan made his escape, dodging the first blasts and sweeping through the forest, running with determination in the direction in which the fiery trails of meteors and fireballs pointed him. Soon, the other Svartalfar survivors would follow. They knew where the Luchuirp made their camp, but it was easy to use the smoky trails as guides, to get there all the faster. But Alazkan was far, far ahead of them. Already, he could see the flashes of spell casting through the foliage.[PARAGRAPH:1]A commotion sounded from outside the generals' tent. The man in the ceremonial armor raised an eyebrow, then quickly wound a small, one-hand crossbow. Others grabbed swords and axes, hefting them in preparation of defending themselves. They felt secure that they were far enough away from the fight, but one never knew if their foe had sent a small force to them as well. Although they would have to be many to get past the guard squad at the door, it was wise to be on the safe side. The commotion was drawing nearer, after all.[PARAGRAPH:1]Alazkan was already in the camp. He knew where the generals' tent was and he was determined to battle his way there. Guards and camp followers fell like leaves in autumn trying to stop him, as he sliced, cut, danced and dodged his way closer, ever closer to his goal. He fell upon the guards outside the tent like divine retribution, cutting them apart with artistic grace and great gore. He was fury, he was revenge, he was a force of nature. And now, he was bursting through the door.[PARAGRAPH:1]The general leveled his crossbow and fired. The bolt drove home with a very final thud.[PARAGRAPH:1]While the men in the tent watched Alazkan's image crumple to the ground and fade, Alazkan stepped from the shadows to complete his mission. His doppelganger had done the job he was meant to do, distract and confuse, so Alazkan could eliminate his quarry and get out alive. The shock generated by his sudden appearance gave his victims no opportunity to act before they were all, without exception, dispatched to the vault of their god. Alazkan, pleased with how easy it had been, spent the rest of the day having sport with the mages and guards, until his allies came and he ran out of quarry.[PARAGRAPH:1]As the dust settled and the ground drank blood, the trees and the mist of the Svartalfar forests closed over the site of the battle and the little camp. The vermin were purged by poison and traps, and the Svartalfar household could return to order and peace.
TEXT.Chinese: Alazkan the Assassin - 刺客阿拉兹干[PARAGRAPH:2]The Luchuirp sculptor carefully chipped through the stone. Alazkan didn't believe the dwarf could damage the treasure inside the statue but he wasn't taking any chances. If the statue had to be broken apart, he would find the most talented to do it.[PARAGRAPH:1]The dwarf blew loose marble away from where he was chiseling, then looked at Alazkan in surprise. A polished piece of jet black could be seen within the white stone.[PARAGRAPH:1]"That's it," Alazkan said, "be careful."[PARAGRAPH:1]To further make his point Alazkan pushed the point of his sword into dwarfs back. It cut easily through the thick leather and made a shallow cut in the sculptors shoulder. The dwarf gasped in pain but continued working carefully to remove the black piece from the statue without damaging it.[PARAGRAPH:1]When he was done a jagged shard of black was revealed. It looked like an opal but flat and about the size of small buckler. On one side it was smooth and so black it looked like a hole in whatever it was laid upon. The other side was polished and reflected Alazkan's image...[PARAGRAPH:1]The sculptor ran for the door. Alazkan looked up only to see a ghostly image of himself burst across the room and then hobble the dwarf with a strike to the back of his knees. The dwarf fell and Alazkan watched his image jump onto him, stab again and the dwarf was dead.[PARAGRAPH:1]In a few seconds the image disappeared. Alazkan wrapped the black shard into his cloak, this would be very handy indeed. Then a Svartalfar hunter Alazkan had assigned to keep guard opened the door.[PARAGRAPH:1]"They are coming" she said.[PARAGRAPH:1]"Good," Alazkan replied, "we are done here."[PARAGRAPH:1]The Luchuirp moved slowly through the forest. A small punitive expedition responding to the sculptors message. They were too late, but it didn't matter, they'd soon regret trying to make retribution upon the servants of the Winter Court. They traveled like elephants, crashing along the path, making a great ruckus, trampling the brush and plants on the lightly worn path into the dust. Alazkan crouched among his sisters, his fellow warriors, and waited for them to come.[PARAGRAPH:1]In a roomy, well-furnished and comfortable tent, far away from the dark and miserable forest the soldiers were slogging through, the Luchuirp commanders gathered around a mage with a scrying glass, listening to his report of their progress. The tent and all the ones around it were set up in a clearing, which was hacked and burned out of the all-encroaching forests that covered and obscured the lands of Faeryl Vinconia, the Queen of Mischief. The generals didn't put themselves in harm's way, they had to be detached from their little army in order to make cool, correct decisions unhindered by the chaos of a surrounding skirmish. But right now, nothing demanded their attention, so they discussed what they would do when the soldiers reached the closest settlement.[PARAGRAPH:1]On a stretch where the path narrowed slightly and the shadows seemed to deepen, the Svartalfar struck. Banshees, witches, amazons, lashing out from the darkness, retreating, and lashing out again, cutting short a man's life every time. Jinxes, curses, knives, darts, arrows and all manner of projectiles flying out between the shadows and the foliage, leaving pain and terror in their wake. Poisoned men raved like lunatics, the wounded screamed and the soldiers yelled and cried in confusion. Alazkan danced and flitted among the confused mass of soldiers. A thrust here, a slash there, with the grace and efficiency of endless practice. Crossbowmen fired bolts blindly, hoping to hit something in the trees, but as often as not hitting their allies, fighting vicious hand-to-hand battles with the Svartalfar in an attempt to strike back at their hidden tormentors. Those who broke and fled along the path were caught in hidden traps, just as lethal as their live foes. The battle was going badly for the Luchuirp, it was going worse than badly, it was disastrous. If it weren't for the fact that they were trapped, it would have been a rout. As it was, ever dwindling pockets of desperate survivors were doing their best to take as many elvish vixens with them as possible before their inevitable demise, fighting with the rage and bitterness of desperate men. Then the spells came.[PARAGRAPH:1]Action among the greying men in the elaborate tent had been swift and decisive. The battle was lost, the men dead anyway. What difference did it make who killed them in the final reckoning? They may as well use the opportunity to strike a blow at their shadowy foes. At least then the soldiers would not have died entirely in vain. The general, a hard man in glittering, polished armor with little practical use, had not hesitated in ordering the mages to saturate the battlefield with their ethereal doom.[PARAGRAPH:1]The fire rained down from the sky, meteors, lightning and fireballs splitting the trees and sending flaming splinters and shards flying between the combatants. Great chunks of earth flew up where meteors struck and heat waves threw bodies around like rag dolls or vaporized unfortunates where they stood. The forest floor was turned to mud, a mud made not of water and dirt, but of blood, and sap, and earth and ash. A cratered wasteland, every bit as hellish as the lands of the Infernal, where elves and dwarves lay, sliced and burned, united in undignified, violent death, a horrific, ever convulsing monument to hatred, composed of limbs, flames and entrails.[PARAGRAPH:1]The scene was pure chaos, the horrible banshee wails of mangled Svartalfar mixing with the despairing, incomprehensible cries of the dwarves that were being sacrificed by their comrades in arms. Survivors sought any cover they could find, skittering desperately away from the destruction. When two foes found the same hole to hide in, a brief fight would erupt, leaving only the victor to cower in safety until another challenger arrived. The air reeked with the odor of the freshly slaughtered, mingled with smoke, earth and the odd smell of magic left behind. And all the while the spells thundered down, pummeling the site again, and again, and again.[PARAGRAPH:1]The men in the tent listened impassively or paced around the tent as the mage conveyed his impressions from the battle. The crackles and fizzes of the mages working their craft could be clearly heard through the thin walls, as could the duller, more distant whooshes and booms of the spells hitting home. Surely, no one could survive such destruction? A great blow was struck this day, a blow which those accursed elves would not soon forget. The generals congratulated each other. Still, they were suitably somber about losing so many brave, but sadly expendable, warriors.[PARAGRAPH:1]Alazkan made his escape, dodging the first blasts and sweeping through the forest, running with determination in the direction in which the fiery trails of meteors and fireballs pointed him. Soon, the other Svartalfar survivors would follow. They knew where the Luchuirp made their camp, but it was easy to use the smoky trails as guides, to get there all the faster. But Alazkan was far, far ahead of them. Already, he could see the flashes of spell casting through the foliage.[PARAGRAPH:1]A commotion sounded from outside the generals' tent. The man in the ceremonial armor raised an eyebrow, then quickly wound a small, one-hand crossbow. Others grabbed swords and axes, hefting them in preparation of defending themselves. They felt secure that they were far enough away from the fight, but one never knew if their foe had sent a small force to them as well. Although they would have to be many to get past the guard squad at the door, it was wise to be on the safe side. The commotion was drawing nearer, after all.[PARAGRAPH:1]Alazkan was already in the camp. He knew where the generals' tent was and he was determined to battle his way there. Guards and camp followers fell like leaves in autumn trying to stop him, as he sliced, cut, danced and dodged his way closer, ever closer to his goal. He fell upon the guards outside the tent like divine retribution, cutting them apart with artistic grace and great gore. He was fury, he was revenge, he was a force of nature. And now, he was bursting through the door.[PARAGRAPH:1]The general leveled his crossbow and fired. The bolt drove home with a very final thud.[PARAGRAPH:1]While the men in the tent watched Alazkan's image crumple to the ground and fade, Alazkan stepped from the shadows to complete his mission. His doppelganger had done the job he was meant to do, distract and confuse, so Alazkan could eliminate his quarry and get out alive. The shock generated by his sudden appearance gave his victims no opportunity to act before they were all, without exception, dispatched to the vault of their god. Alazkan, pleased with how easy it had been, spent the rest of the day having sport with the mages and guards, until his allies came and he ran out of quarry.[PARAGRAPH:1]As the dust settled and the ground drank blood, the trees and the mist of the Svartalfar forests closed over the site of the battle and the little camp. The vermin were purged by poison and traps, and the Svartalfar household could return to order and peace.

TEXT.English: 阿拉兹干开局便带有隐藏国籍与英雄晋升，这一组合极适于骚扰所谓的盟友，但最为实用的是他的镜像能力，可召唤出一个虚幻的分身。幻影无法击杀单位，却完美适于削弱任何防守者，好让阿拉兹干将其斩杀，而不必让自己陷入虚弱、遭到反击。阿拉兹干及其镜像分身也都将拥有神射手晋升。

TEXT.English: Angel of Death - 死亡天使[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 死亡天使是隐形的，天生具有死亡接触技能，每次攻击能够减少敌方城市1人口。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “人们无法逃避死亡天使，也不能与他讨价还价，诸如‘请等我完成任务’或 ‘用我的儿子、奴隶代替我’之类的哀求是行不通的。”当死亡天使出现时，没有人能够拯救你。

TEXT.English: Angel - 天使[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]无生命的我被吸收转生为植物，[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]植物的我被动物咀嚼而死去。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]动物的我死亡并转生为人类。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]为何要恐惧死亡伴随的失去？[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]人类的我终将再度的死去[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]并转生为一个从头到脚完美的天使！[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]当天使的我分解消失时，[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]我将化身为超越人类的概念！[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]让我的存在化身为虚无，君临万物之上[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]以管风琴歌颂我，“此声将令我归来。”

TEXT.English: Archer - 弓手[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 弓箭是一种简单有效的武器，经过少量训练的弓手就是敌人的严重威胁。由于需要弓手需要专门的武器和基本的训练，弓手们成为领袖，行会或是城市领导下的半职业军队。凭借他们天生的嗅觉，弓手们努力的防守城市，藏匿直到合适的时机才出来攻击，向敌人释放地狱般呼啸着的复仇之箭。没有什么比阵阵箭雨和对死亡无所畏惧更能削弱敌人的攻势了。

TEXT.English: 无需资源，天生享有城市防御奖励，弓手是最便宜的城市防守者。弓手可以升级所有的城防晋升，使他们成为超越自己等级的防守者。

TEXT.English: Arquebus - 火绳枪[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 矮人们掌握了火药的奥妙。他们使用火药爆破开路。人类花了很多年才从这些大地之子口中套出其中的秘密。但是一旦成功，火药很快便在武器上得到了应用。尽管沉重，精度低，难以重复填药，火绳枪还是具有两大优势：恫吓和威力。火绳枪可以无视城墙，那仿佛是纸做的一般。

TEXT.English: 死亡使者阿尔斯·墨里恩迪
TEXT.Chinese: 死亡使者阿尔斯·墨里恩迪

TEXT.English: Ars Moriendi - 死亡使者阿尔斯·墨里恩迪[PARAGRAPH:2]Parih stood unmoving, surrounded by the chaos of the battlefield. The screams and clash of weapons were only distant echoes to him. Soldiers fought and died for the ground he stood on, but he did not budge. They pushed through him, and he could not feel it.[PARAGRAPH:1]His broken body lay before him, covered with blood and indistinguishable from the corpses of enemies that lay around him. The Hippus had appeared so different to him, like another breed of men, before now. A lifetime of stories meant to turn hearts against them, extolling the differences in their culture and history. But now they looked the same, battered and bloody.[PARAGRAPH:1]The world faded around him, it would be as if Parih's vision grew worse except he felt so real and the world seemed to be nothing but a dream. The sounds of battle were replaced by the whispered prayers of the soldiers. A few requesting protection, most asking for the death of their enemies, all scared.[PARAGRAPH:1]"Are you prepared for death?"[PARAGRAPH:1]The words reached into Parih, seeking the answer, touching every dark thought he maintained. A man on a pale horse rode toward him and though Parih felt evil from the man he was unable to lie.[PARAGRAPH:1]"I'm scared."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Do not be afraid of death, you have been dead before. Do you believe that time began when you were born? Do you believe your soul to be immortal?"[PARAGRAPH:1]Parih was unable to answer. The demon smirked.[PARAGRAPH:1]"You are not the catalyst of creation, flesh is an unfit and temporary vessel for a soul. If you know that your soul exists after your life ends, shouldn't you believe that it existed before your birth? And if your soul existed in a place before your birth, why would it not return there after your death?"[PARAGRAPH:1]The demon paused, reading Parih's thoughts, making sure this was the correct moment.[PARAGRAPH:1]"Take my hand mortal and I will lead you to the afterlife."[PARAGRAPH:1]Parih reached out and took Ars skeletal hand. In that instant the memories of his life were lost and he was reborn as one of the mindless Mane legions of hell.[PARAGRAPH:1]"That soul was not yours to claim demon!"[PARAGRAPH:1]Ars turned to see a Valkyrie with her weapon drawn. She paled when she recognized him, instinctively stepping back even though he hadn't made any move towards her.[PARAGRAPH:1]"I am unbound, and claim any I choose."[PARAGRAPH:1]He rode forward and the Valkyrie moved out of his way.

She paled when she recognized him, instinctively stepping back even though he hadn't made any move towards her.[PARAGRAPH:1]"I am unbound, and claim any I choose."[PARAGRAPH:1]He rode forward and the Valkyrie moved out of his way.

TEXT.English: 整整一个连队都被她屠戮殆尽。她身着一袭褴褛的白裙，一头纠结的红发，二者都像煎锅上的油脂般黏附在她身上。她不带任何武器，她也不需要。她的利爪如铁一般，比任何女孩都强壮。可她不过是个女孩，或至少曾经是。她又抓又咬，咳嗽着、喘息着，逃走了。他们中有一人死了，另有几人受了伤。[PARAGRAPH:1]阿森丹开始为伤口敷上治疗的药膏，可它们已因感染泛起绿色。手指粗的道道裂口迸开，皮肤与肌肉向后翻卷，仿佛想要逃离骨头。他们在剧痛中扭动，不出几分钟便如同遭了鞭笞；再过几分钟，他们看上去就像刚变的丧尸，仍在尖叫，躯体死去而心智尚存。而后终于，仁慈地，他们死了。[PARAGRAPH:1]阿森丹在那场厮杀中毫发无伤，可那疫病仍在蔓延。他抄起弩，一心要确保那女孩不再把她的疫病散播开去。当他握住弩那打磨光亮的握柄时，他注意到自己的双手也开始泛红肿胀。他急忙奔向水边；他们身处普雷斯普尔城下的下水道，平时他绝不会碰这里的水，可它总该好过沾在他身上的东西。他擦洗双手，情形却只是愈发糟糕，随后咳嗽开始了。[PARAGRAPH:1]他听见自己在尖叫，与其他人一模一样。他栽进水里，死了。[PARAGRAPH:1]疫病在水中蔓延；次日清晨，全城本会在一场瘟疫中醒来。到日暮时分，若非苏塞鲁斯出手干预，几乎就无人幸存了。他的影子穿过下水道，把疫病收进一只陶瓶。他向水说话，水便将阿森丹从深处托起，安放在这位神祇脚边。苏塞鲁斯请求得到这矮人的魂灵，阿拉温应允了。[PARAGRAPH:1]阿森丹记不清太多，从擦洗双手到次日清晨在一家本地酒馆醒来，一切都不过是一片模糊。他记得一个治好了他的人。他记得被交予那只瓶子，被叮嘱要妥善保管、永不开启。他记得被告知，他必须找到那个女孩。而直到今日，他仍在朝着那个目标努力。

TEXT.English: 只能加入信奉基鲁莫夫之痕宗教的文明。可以医治疾病，自身对疾病免疫。

TEXT.English: Assassin - 刺客[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 当一名猎人投身于丛林去追捕最难以捕捉的动物时，一个刺客诞生了。虽然不擅长城市战斗，但刺客优先攻击集团中最弱单位的能力使得他可以直接攻击脆弱的法师单位。

TEXT.English: Axeman - 斧兵[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 早在远古时代人们便开始使用斧头，而且不仅仅用作生产的工具。当人类从神祗那儿学会冶炼金属的技巧时，屠杀近邻的技艺便有了质的飞跃。战斧，是矮人首选的武器，在人类手中也相当可怕，伴随着恐惧将骨肉斩裂，效果极佳。金属的战斧昂贵且制造困难，仅供精英战士中少数拥有特权者使用，这些人通常都是贵族的近卫。这些职业军人通常是在无尽的氏族仇杀中成长起来的经验丰富的老兵，在战斗中这些经验给予他们极大的优势。他们残忍冷酷，毫无怜悯之心，知道怎样能够干掉那些缺乏经验的士兵。那些不受重用或被驱逐的斧战士通常会成为蛮族部落中的精英战士或头领的私人卫队。这些头脑冷静的杀人机器往往比那些拥有众多杂牌勋章的战士更加可怕。

TEXT.English: Bambur - 矮人班布尔[PARAGRAPH:2]An artist named Kheldon Ki was called before a wealthy lord and ordered to produce a statue of the lord to stand before his home for all the populace to see and revere. Kheldon Ki was a gifted artist, and all art he created was so lifelike it showed the true soul of its subject. As such, his statue of the lord radiated a sense of ego and vanity to all who looked at it. When the lord saw the completed statue, he ordered it torn down and Kheldon to spend the rest of his life in his deepest dungeons. Kheldon spent 40 years within the dungeon, blind and lonely. To fight his loneliness, he began sculpting people from the rocks in the cavern. By the end of his life, he had created hundreds of these stocky statues of men and woman all doing a variety of tasks. At a great age Kheldon lay upon the floor of the dungeon close to death. It was then that Kilmorph appeared before him and said "You have been imprisoned unjustly, for this I will grant you a wish. Choose your wish carefully though, for you will gain only one, be it for revenge against the lord who imprisoned you or a renewal of youth for you to live again." In this way Kilmorph hoped to test Kheldon, to see if he had become so bitter as to be unworthy of heaven by wishing for revenge against the lord. But Kheldon asked for neither of these two things, and instead said "I wish not revenge for it would gain me nothing, and I wish not new life, for I am ready to die; my only wish is that during my final hours I would not be alone." Kilmorph saw this as a good wish, and granted it by breathing life into all the statues Kheldon had created, and they tended to him until he died. After Kheldon's death, his soul was carried to the underworld on the back of a great dragon, and he was welcomed among the spirits of his ancestors. As for the stone people, they burrowed out of the lord's dungeon and spread through the underdark, becoming the dwarves of today.[PARAGRAPH:1]Bambur is one of the few original dwarves remaining. He was carved by Kheldon and had Kilmorph herself breathe life into him. He is nearly as talented a crafter as his creator, but Bambur makes weapons instead of statues.[PARAGRAPH:1]The first generation of Dwarves never age, they are exactly as they were when they were carved, but each generation of dwarves gets a slightly shorter lifespan. As they get farther and farther from the breath of Kilmorph, they become more mortal, in spirit and life. Bambur has had to watch this fall, the Umberguard himself has even turned away from Kilmorph, but Bambur fights on for his goddess and mother. His strength, and his weapons, are available to any that fights for Kilmorph.

TEXT.English: 矮人班布尔只能加入信奉基鲁莫夫之痕的国家。他是一个战士和武器制造者，可以为同一区域的肉搏单位提供武器强化和进行修理。
TEXT.Chinese: 矮人班布尔只能加入信奉基鲁莫夫之痕的国家。他是一个战士和武器制造者，可以为同一区域的肉搏单位提供武器强化和进行修理。

TEXT.English: Barnaxus - 傀儡王巴纳克苏斯[PARAGRAPH:2]Barnaxus was beautiful, perfect. The pinnacle of years of work, of finding the right words to power him, of selecting just the right pieces, of lovingly sculpting every little detail of his joints and his features. Barnaxus was more nimble, more exact, more careful and more effective in everything he did than any of the other golems that were built in the empire of Khrad'Ke-zun. For many hundred years, this giant did as he was told, when he was told, and always did it better than anyone else, dwarven or golem. Barnaxus works were the pride of the Empire, and, when the ice sheets smothered the world, the name and reputation of Barnaxus passed into legend.[PARAGRAPH:1]Perhaps it was this legendary status that meant that when, years after the Ice had pulled back and the Luchuirp embarked on their mission of rebuilding the Empire, a tall, weather-worn golem appeared at the gates of the capital, he was instantly recognized as the long-lost Barnaxus. For, surely, only a golem of such perfection and brilliance as Barnaxus could have survived so long without maintenance and protection? [PARAGRAPH:1]It quickly became clear that Barnaxus was unlike any other golem. Barnaxus did not "take orders." He cooperated, he discussed, and he made suggestions. Barnaxus was a thinking golem, a learning golem. No one could guess how he had managed to break the magical ties that bind a golem to the two-dimensional world of "order and execution", and nobody really expected that they would ever find out. When asked, Barnaxus merely said: "A man spoke to me in the wastes and I awoke," he would say no more. [PARAGRAPH:1]True, Barnaxus could do what he wished, but what he wished was to help the Luchuirp. He wished to help them rebuild the Empire, to recall what was forgotten, and to perfect what was remembered. He appeared to harbor a love for the Luchuirp that mirrored that of a doting father, with a hint of a patronizing air to some of his advice. And the Luchuirp, amazingly, instead of rankling at being "taught" by a golem, loved him back. He was their link to the past and an amazing store of knowledge. Golems, after all, never forget. But most important of all, Barnaxus also taught the golems. What Barnaxus learned, the other golems soon copied. [PARAGRAPH:1]And so it was that Barnaxus went from being the "King of the Golems" to being a true leader of golems and of dwarves.

TEXT.English: 作为第一个“活”的魔像，傀儡王巴纳克苏斯可以通过改变来适应环境。更令人叫绝的是，它可以与同一国家的魔像分享知识。在游戏中的作用是如果傀儡王巴纳克苏斯拥有格斗Ⅰ—Ⅴ级晋升，同一国家的其他魔像可以增强力量。当它被杀死时，只要将它的碎片带回任何一个鲁崔尔普矮人部族城市，它就会被重铸。
TEXT.Chinese: 作为第一个“活”的魔像，傀儡王巴纳克苏斯可以通过改变来适应环境。更令人叫绝的是，它可以与同一国家的魔像分享知识。在游戏中的作用是如果傀儡王巴纳克苏斯拥有格斗Ⅰ—Ⅴ级晋升，同一国家的其他魔像可以增强力量。当它被杀死时，只要将它的碎片带回任何一个鲁崔尔普矮人部族城市，它就会被重铸。

TEXT.English: 铁锤巴希姆愿意冲锋陷阵而不愿坐下来休息。虽然强大，发动战争会增加他死亡的风险。如果铁锤巴希姆死亡，召唤他的文明将丧失该文明的特质。
TEXT.Chinese: 铁锤巴希姆愿意冲锋陷阵而不愿坐下来休息。虽然强大，发动战争会增加他死亡的风险。如果铁锤巴希姆死亡，召唤他的文明将丧失该文明的特质。

TEXT.English: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]冲车[COLOR_REVERT]只能被卡扎德王国的肉搏单位建造。这个单位比如位于森林中，然后点击[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]建造冲车[COLOR_REVERT]按钮。
TEXT.Chinese: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]冲车[COLOR_REVERT]只能被卡扎德王国的肉搏单位建造。这个单位比如位于森林中，然后点击[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]建造冲车[COLOR_REVERT]按钮。

TEXT.English: Battlemaster - 战场支配者[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The role of Battlemasters are filled by the younger sons of families. Typically the eldest son received his father's inheritance, assuming he was strong enough to keep it, and the younger sons were eager to join raids and battles to earn treasures to equal their brother's inheritance. The best of these became Battlemasters and often far exceeded the birthright they would have had through inheritance. Even when raids were particularly unrewarding often the military experience was enough hat they would return and take the inheritance from their older brothers. - from "Pack of Wolves" by Dentaro.
TEXT.Chinese: Battlemaster - 战场支配者[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The role of Battlemasters are filled by the younger sons of families. Typically the eldest son received his father's inheritance, assuming he was strong enough to keep it, and the younger sons were eager to join raids and battles to earn treasures to equal their brother's inheritance. The best of these became Battlemasters and often far exceeded the birthright they would have had through inheritance. Even when raids were particularly unrewarding often the military experience was enough hat they would return and take the inheritance from their older brothers. - from "Pack of Wolves" by Dentaro.

TEXT.English: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]战场支配者[COLOR_REVERT]替代其他文明的[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]冠军斗士[COLOR_REVERT]，他们没有建造前提，并且在冻土上有巨大加成。

TEXT.English: Bear - 熊[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]生态：[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 熊会在地面上漫游来寻找可以建造兽穴的地方建穴。兽穴有时会产生新的熊。
TEXT.Chinese: Bear - 熊[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]生态：[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 熊会在地面上漫游来寻找可以建造兽穴的地方建穴。兽穴有时会产生新的熊。

TEXT.English: Beast of Agares - 邪神妖兽[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 邪神妖兽只能被信奉[LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]混沌之灰烬[\LINK]的文明召唤。生产邪神妖兽需要消耗4个人口。注意生产它的城市会暴乱一段时间。
TEXT.Chinese: Beast of Agares - 邪神妖兽[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 邪神妖兽只能被信奉[LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]混沌之灰烬[\LINK]的文明召唤。生产邪神妖兽需要消耗4个人口。注意生产它的城市会暴乱一段时间。

TEXT.English: Beastmaster - 兽王[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 最强大的侦查单位。兽王能够将自己的力量与他统治的动物的力量结合起来（而且装饰着一种鼬鼠咬过的奇怪树枝）。可以使被击败的动物单位转化。生产兽王需要镇守之祀。
TEXT.Chinese: Beastmaster - 兽王[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 最强大的侦查单位。兽王能够将自己的力量与他统治的动物的力量结合起来（而且装饰着一种鼬鼠咬过的奇怪树枝）。可以使被击败的动物单位转化。生产兽王需要镇守之祀。

TEXT.English: 极佳的攻击部队，可以给对方造成群伤。他们的防御力很弱，因此需要一些防御里高的部队来保护他们。
TEXT.Chinese: 极佳的攻击部队，可以给对方造成群伤。他们的防御力很弱，因此需要一些防御里高的部队来保护他们。

TEXT.English: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]猛牛骑兵[COLOR_REVERT]速度较慢，但力量更强。
TEXT.Chinese: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]猛牛骑兵[COLOR_REVERT]速度较慢，但力量更强。

TEXT.English: The Black Wind - 黑风号战舰[PARAGRAPH:2]Oh, heave and ho, and away we go, faster than you'll e'er see![NEWLINE]Oh, heave and ho, and away we go, faster than the navy![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Listen me hearties an' I'll sing ye the tale,[NEWLINE]of the a fearsome ship, aye, Hell did send [NEWLINE]out of the depths, in a midnight gale.[NEWLINE]The fabled vessel name o' Black Wind.[NEWLINE]Cunning was the captain[NEWLINE]Of this dauntless vessel fair,[NEWLINE]Though they never plundered but a coin,[NEWLINE]'twas always 'nough to share![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Oh, heave and ho, and away we go, faster than you'll e'er see![NEWLINE]Oh, heave and ho, and away we go, faster than the navy![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The boat herself was a sturdy old gel,[NEWLINE]Nigh invincible they'll tell you,[NEWLINE]Her hull was strong, and the mast as well,[NEWLINE]She could take whatever you'd do.[NEWLINE]Why they say she rammed a Queen O' the line[NEWLINE]Cloaked in the fog, dead a-winter[NEWLINE]You think that stopped a ship this fine?[NEWLINE]Well--least they had a carpenter![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Oh, heave and ho, and away we go, faster than you'll e'er see![NEWLINE]Oh, heave and ho, and away we go, faster than the navy![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The crew was brave, the terror o' the seas,[NEWLINE]Hardened men of every stripe,[NEWLINE]The bounty on them could have pleased[NEWLINE]Even the greediest type.[NEWLINE]O'l Black Wind 's crew was the boldest lot,[NEWLINE]That's why they're in our chantey's,[NEWLINE]This verse goes out to their wildest plot,[NEWLINE]When they stole ol' Hannah's panties![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Oh, heave and ho, and away we go, faster than you'll e'er see![NEWLINE]Oh, heave and ho, and away we go, faster than the navies![NEWLINE][NEWLINE][TAB]-Lanun Pirate Chantey

TEXT.English: 隐藏国籍，海上霸主，不用理会什么“协议”。
TEXT.Chinese: 隐藏国籍，海上霸主，不用理会什么“协议”。

TEXT.English: Bloodpet - 血畜[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 卡拉比姆社会中介于普通人和血族战士之间的嗜血怪物。侍奉在吸血鬼身边做着各种仆人的工作，而不仅仅是做战时的炮灰。凭借和主人的关系有时可以参加宴会。但是到了危急关头却总是牺牲品。
TEXT.Chinese: Bloodpet - 血畜[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 卡拉比姆社会中介于普通人和血族战士之间的嗜血怪物。侍奉在吸血鬼身边做着各种仆人的工作，而不仅仅是做战时的炮灰。凭借和主人的关系有时可以参加宴会。但是到了危急关头却总是牺牲品。

TEXT.English: 在早期防御和侦察方面与其他战士一样实用，如果吸血鬼使用“食用”技能吃掉他们，能够增加额外的移动力，而且可以再次攻击。
TEXT.Chinese: 在早期防御和侦察方面与其他战士一样实用，如果吸血鬼使用“食用”技能吃掉他们，能够增加额外的移动力，而且可以再次攻击。

TEXT.English: 山猪骑兵是游戏中最差的骑手。可这不过是个骑猪的矮人，你还指望什么呢？
TEXT.Chinese: 山猪骑兵是游戏中最差的骑手。可这不过是个骑猪的矮人，你还指望什么呢？

TEXT.English: Boarding Party - 海盗[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 大多数应征入伍的拉努恩海盗只能做一辈子下等水手。那些有才能的会被训练成海盗。如果经受充足训练的话，也是无敌的——至少在海上如此。这些海上的猴子永远渴望游到敌人的船上为得到财宝战斗。
TEXT.Chinese: Boarding Party - 海盗[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 大多数应征入伍的拉努恩海盗只能做一辈子下等水手。那些有才能的会被训练成海盗。如果经受充足训练的话，也是无敌的——至少在海上如此。这些海上的猴子永远渴望游到敌人的船上为得到财宝战斗。

TEXT.English: 可以攻击其他海军单位。胜利时可取得对方舰船的控制权。
TEXT.Chinese: 可以攻击其他海军单位。胜利时可取得对方舰船的控制权。

TEXT.English: Bone Golem - 骨魔像[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 骨魔像初现于[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]重生时代[COLOR_REVERT]。每一部分都完全由骨头或类似材料构成。只有[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]冰河时代[COLOR_REVERT]幸存下来的猛犸象才能提供合适尺寸的材料。好奇心驱使鲁崔尔普的工匠们制作了这些他们喜爱的玩具。这些骨头蕴藏了其他材料所没有的魔力，使得魔像被打散后仍可复活。

TEXT.English: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]骨魔像[COLOR_REVERT]替代[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]不朽战士[COLOR_REVERT]，可被直接生产。它们的重生不会给你带来一个高经验的单位，但至少你不用再做一个。

TEXT.English: Brigit - 女神布里吉特[PARAGRAPH:2]She withered in the onslaught of flames, for the first time feeling the sensation of burning. It was as if she dove into the sun. Tears of gold ran down her sword, so hot it was melting before reaching its target. Her armor popped and warped and her wings were little more than charred stubs.[PARAGRAPH:1]Behind her 440 angels fought against thousands. There was little hope but they fought because hope was not required, only passion for what they were. And hatred for what they would not become.[PARAGRAPH:1]They were all hurling down. Bhall had succumbed, and in that thought destroyed the heaven that they all occupied. She paid little attention to the war raging around her, a battlefield streaking through the sky, angels flying, burning and killing each other. Bhall was the burning heart of the inferno, like a massive meteor surrounded by thousands of shattered pieces, and Brigit was diving towards her.[PARAGRAPH:1]Brigit landed on her chest, her willpower split between protecting herself, guiding her movements and reaching out to Bhall. Brigit was barely taller than the goddess head but she raised her sword to drive it through to Bhall's heart.[PARAGRAPH:1]"My queen, you must recant. The men and gods all stand on your strength. In your loss you will consume creation."[PARAGRAPH:1]There was no response, Brigit raised her sword again, but she could not finish the motion. It was not the pain, or the fall, she was simply unable to do it.[PARAGRAPH:1]"Can you not kill me child?"[PARAGRAPH:1]Bhall's words rang through each of her angel's. Behind her Brigit could see the ground nearing, there was a great city below with tall spires and vast domed temples.[PARAGRAPH:1]"You cannot fall, you won't let this happen!"[PARAGRAPH:1]Bhall closed her eyes, as if considering the statement, then lashed out at her highest angel grabbing Brigit in her right hand and pointing her left toward the mass of warring angels. In that second each of the 440 angels that hadn't followed Bhall that had remained loyal to her holy dominion was incinerated in pale yellow flames. The thousands that had followed their queen cheered, Brigit could see that they were already being transformed by their fall into twisted horrid shapes. Of all of Bhalls angels only Brigit remained pure and beautiful.[PARAGRAPH:1]"You will not join me?"[PARAGRAPH:1]"No." Brigit remained absolute.[PARAGRAPH:1]Just before striking the ground Bhall threw Brigit away from her. To a place where fire creatures would never go, deep into the lands of snow and ice. Bhall's commands chased after her, forming a prison for the archangel, a ring of lights that burn anyone who tries to pass through it. And to this day Brigit remains trapped within it.

TEXT.English: Brujah - 狂暴吸血鬼[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 吸血鬼不会厌恶自己的残忍天性，大部分吸血鬼喜欢通过有节制的虐待来发泄自己的野性。狂暴吸血鬼却不是这样。经历长期的战乱后，那些在[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]冰河时代[COLOR_REVERT]中被卡拉比姆公国用作生存依靠的脆弱文明早已纷纷崩溃。甚至在这种吸血鬼领主仅满足于稀少食物的困难时期，狂暴吸血鬼仍陶醉于战斗的虐杀，甚至甘冒毁灭自己不朽生命的风险。当然，他们的结局是无庸置疑的。

TEXT.English: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]狂暴吸血鬼[COLOR_REVERT]是[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]狂战士[COLOR_REVERT]的替代单位，可对4个单位造成群伤。他们同样具有吸血鬼初始自带的全部能力。
TEXT.Chinese: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]狂暴吸血鬼[COLOR_REVERT]是[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]狂战士[COLOR_REVERT]的替代单位，可对4个单位造成群伤。他们同样具有吸血鬼初始自带的全部能力。

TEXT.English: Buboes - 战争使者布勃厄斯[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 他们由尸体拼凑而成，不受死亡的约束，是和平的死敌。手握宝剑，可以像巨石般摧毁房屋。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 在那个时代神和万物是对应的。树木是[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]苏塞鲁斯[COLOR_REVERT]的天堂的金色柱子的绿色沉思，蝴蝶是文雅的[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]阿玛萨恩[COLOR_REVERT]的飘散思绪。但神们也会感到恐惧，他们担心的事情终于发生了。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 跳跃躲闪，是他们害怕的表现，布勃厄斯仍然是神创世界的一部分。如果摆脱束缚他将把神的担忧化为现实，整个埃瑞布斯都将被他的宝剑击得粉碎。
TEXT.Chinese: Buboes - 战争使者布勃厄斯[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 他们由尸体拼凑而成，不受死亡的约束，是和平的死敌。手握宝剑，可以像巨石般摧毁房屋。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 在那个时代神和万物是对应的。树木是[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]苏塞鲁斯[COLOR_REVERT]的天堂的金色柱子的绿色沉思，蝴蝶是文雅的[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]阿玛萨恩[COLOR_REVERT]的飘散思绪。但神们也会感到恐惧，他们担心的事情终于发生了。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 跳跃躲闪，是他们害怕的表现，布勃厄斯仍然是神创世界的一部分。如果摆脱束缚他将把神的担忧化为现实，整个埃瑞布斯都将被他的宝剑击得粉碎。

TEXT.English: Camel Archer - 骆驼骑射手[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 已经习惯于躲避沙暴的各个埃瑞布斯文明在[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]重生时代[COLOR_REVERT]晚期偶然发现了这些动物，训练有素的骆驼加上经验丰富的骑手可以媲美强大沙尘暴，他们来无影去无踪。训练建造这些丑陋的动物需要赛马场。

TEXT.English: Cannon - 加农炮[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 加农炮随着火药的发明而出现，极大的改变了攻城战的模式。最早的加农炮由一名武僧发明，使用火药发射石块和铁球。因为加农炮可以轻易地将那些高大坚固的城墙炸得粉碎，所以防御工事被迫做出了极大改变。

TEXT.English: Caravel - 轻帆船[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 轻帆船是小型船只，拥有三到四根桅杆，宽阔的船头和狭窄的船尾。尽管常常用作战船，轻帆船也可以运载100吨左右的货物。

TEXT.English: Cowtapult - 投石车[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 投石车是炮兵的鼻祖。使用大型机械臂远距离发射大石块或其他发射物，摧毁围墙，建筑物和防守者。投石车的射程是500到1000英尺。投石车虽然在战场上笨重无用，却是围城战的有效武器。

TEXT.English: Berserker - 狂战士[PARAGRAPH:2]Doviello Berserkers carry crude weapons into battle, a throwing rock bigger than a man's head or a stout branch. They use these makeshift weapons because they are temporary. The first opponent killed became the weapon of choice. Grabbed by the ankles they would be swung like a meaty flail. Blood sprayed over opponents and every swing would lose more and more of the corpse until another was needed to replace the first. At this point in the battle the "weapons" were always readily available. Occasionally an opponent would be grabbed while still alive. The effect of being beaten by a bloody body that was screaming at you while it happened is traumatizing to even the most hardened warrior. Few armies were willing to face them. - from "Pack of Wolves" by Dentaro

TEXT.English: Clockwork Golem - 发条魔像[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 这种精致的东西是鲁崔尔普矮人部族利用机械工场的精良工具以及诸如铁或秘银等优质金属创造的杰作。附有魔力的精细弹簧与齿轮使它反应灵敏，能够与狂暴的魔兽匹敌。发条魔像能造成4单位附带伤害、但是自我回复的速度极低，最好和一个有修理晋升的单位同行。

TEXT.English: Great Commander - 大指挥官[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 大指挥官可以招募单位，在城市中建造指挥所，或者与一个单位结合增加他的力量和战斗中获得的经验。招募能力可以获得随机的单位，但是建立指挥所会有更好的长期效果：增加城市的大指挥官点数使之更容易产生大指挥官。大指挥官随时可以与结合的单位分离来与另一个单位结合。
TEXT.Chinese: Great Commander - 大指挥官[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 大指挥官可以招募单位，在城市中建造指挥所，或者与一个单位结合增加他的力量和战斗中获得的经验。招募能力可以获得随机的单位，但是建立指挥所会有更好的长期效果：增加城市的大指挥官点数使之更容易产生大指挥官。大指挥官随时可以与结合的单位分离来与另一个单位结合。

TEXT.English: Corlindale - 大法师科林戴尔[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 科尔戴林行走在林立的护墙之间，他的心里充满激动与不安。初次的战斗！他就是为此接受训练的。他长年在阿姆莱特城堡中学习，硬着头皮阅读那些破旧发霉的厚重书籍，练习那些冗长而又拗口的咒语。在老师喋喋不休地念叨远古咒文与魔法的奇异的时候，他心中却默默祈祷希望一切早已失传。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 与他的同行的法师面无表情地列队前进着。他意识到这么激动只会让他看起来像个傻瓜，于是他尽力模仿其他人的表情，却显得相当不自然。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 接踵而至的便是混乱！勒约沙尔法的士兵从树梢上的隐蔽处现身，猛烈的箭雨射向这群毫无防备的法师，严整的队形被打乱，人人争相逃窜，可幸免于难的只有他一个。在那慌乱时刻，他本能地唤出了一段保护咒文，随后发狂般地逃命。如今他只身一人站在敌人城市的街道上。谢天谢地，大多数敌军都在外墙防御进攻。行走在空旷的街道上，他惊讶于那些参天古树。他觉得自己仿佛身处梦境，周围的景色如此神奇，杀戮的呐喊又是多么遥远。他突然发现自己回想不起这场战争的起因了——是边界冲突？还是精灵太热衷于保护能量之源？现在这一切都无关紧要了。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 忽然间他看到一支精灵巡逻队从街向这走来。有个精灵发现了他，便用优美动听的精灵语大声呼喊。卫兵小心翼翼地逼近科尔戴林，他们明白阿姆莱特法师的威力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 但接下来的事对他们而言可不太好受。科尔戴林用双手聚集周围空气的热量，形成了一个巨大的火球——很幸运最近的阴雨天气不会让它造成一场森林火灾。他掷出火球，紧闭双眼以免被随后的爆炸烈焰灼伤。领头的精灵变成了一堆灰烬，其余的幸存者丢下武器逃跑了。“一群懦夫！”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 带着莫名的兴奋，他继续向前走去。初次的胜利令他觉得自己无比强大——这在那些年轻人的战斗生涯中经常会出现——他期望遇到更多的敌人。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 片刻之后，他的愿望得到了满足。背后传来树叶的沙沙声，使他立刻作好了施放火球的准备。怀着对先前那阵箭雨的恐惧，他不想给敌人留下任何机会。他迅速地转身同时将火球掷向声音传来的方向，时间凝固了。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 在他面前的站着一位女性精灵，她有着银色的长发，美丽的杏眼，但脸上充满恐惧之情。而她的身边还有两个孩子，他们紧紧地依偎着自己的母亲。一个女孩年纪稍长，她和母亲有着同样美丽的面容——也带着相同的恐惧。那个年幼的男孩则不安而又好奇地盯着急速飞来的火球。仿佛过了数个世纪他才反应过来。他竭力伸出双手，似乎这样就可以把火球重新拉回来。他疯狂地祈求着火球能够停下，而不是向着毁灭的目标飞去，即使火球掉过头向他袭来也心甘情愿。但这一切都不起作用，他做了不了任何事去避免惨剧的发生，而这世上也不存在能够扭转他的魔法的力量。他闭上了双眼，他无力的哀号被痛苦的惨叫所掩盖。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 某个深秋的夜晚，一位陌生人出现在了埃尔希姆大陆的卡西尔阿比耶城门前，他披着一件棕色的斗篷，上面没有任何用以识别的记号。看上去他相当的疲惫，于是守卫让他进了城，并为他提供了食物。有些好事之徒想要打探出他从何方而来，但看一眼陌生人的眼睛就会明白他们什么也得不到。那是心灵遭受巨大创伤的眼神，它们的主人经历了残酷的命运。

TEXT.English: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]大法师科林戴尔[COLOR_REVERT]是一个伟大的法师，他长于外交。他可以自我牺牲来换取你和所有当前的文明和谈，并将他们的军队赶出国境。但要注意敌方的刺客！
TEXT.Chinese: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]大法师科林戴尔[COLOR_REVERT]是一个伟大的法师，他长于外交。他可以自我牺牲来换取你和所有当前的文明和谈，并将他们的军队赶出国境。但要注意敌方的刺客！

TEXT.English: Courtesan - 名妓[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 名妓过着与平民有天壤之别的纸醉金迷的生活。几乎所有国家都利用名妓的美貌、机智与才能刺探贵族们的想法。在[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]重生时代[COLOR_REVERT]巴尔塞拉弗族也利用她们进行秘密的情报活动。一个微笑可以让寂寞的边境守卫放行，再多付出一些就能够进入首都。稍后她们伪装成平民，采用各种手段使自己益发显耀，最后刺杀敌方重要首脑，趁着夜色逃之夭夭。
TEXT.Chinese: Courtesan - 名妓[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 名妓过着与平民有天壤之别的纸醉金迷的生活。几乎所有国家都利用名妓的美貌、机智与才能刺探贵族们的想法。在[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]重生时代[COLOR_REVERT]巴尔塞拉弗族也利用她们进行秘密的情报活动。一个微笑可以让寂寞的边境守卫放行，再多付出一些就能够进入首都。稍后她们伪装成平民，采用各种手段使自己益发显耀，最后刺杀敌方重要首脑，趁着夜色逃之夭夭。

TEXT.English: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]名妓[COLOR_REVERT]不可见，并且攻击叠堆中最弱小的单位，是[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]主教[COLOR_REVERT]和[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]大法师[COLOR_REVERT]的克星。

TEXT.English: Crossbowman - 弩兵[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 弩是初次起义中农民们最好的武器。弩的制造工艺简单，可以大量生产，能够轻易地击穿铠甲。这意味着农民可以与由骑士组成的保皇党军队一决高下。弩的结构非常简单：用绞盘绷紧弓绳——单靠臂力几乎是不可能的。发射物基本上和去掉箭头的箭差不多。弩可以沿直线射向目标不会偏差太大，不需要太多的训练。
TEXT.Chinese: Crossbowman - 弩兵[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 弩是初次起义中农民们最好的武器。弩的制造工艺简单，可以大量生产，能够轻易地击穿铠甲。这意味着农民可以与由骑士组成的保皇党军队一决高下。弩的结构非常简单：用绞盘绷紧弓绳——单靠臂力几乎是不可能的。发射物基本上和去掉箭头的箭差不多。弩可以沿直线射向目标不会偏差太大，不需要太多的训练。

TEXT.English: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]弩兵[COLOR_REVERT]是城市中的终极守卫，有他们在的城市，除非敌方拥有强大的攻城武器或是法师，否则几乎是无法被攻陷的。因此，准备好[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]刺客[COLOR_REVERT]和[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]神射手[COLOR_REVERT]去干掉对方的攻城力量吧。

TEXT.English: Crusader - 十字军[PARAGRAPH:2]The Crusaders are always at the front of the fight when the Order goes to war. When they are not dispatching their enemies to their false gods, the Crusaders are striding up and down the lines helping their wounded comrades or saying the final rites over those who have died at the hands of the ungodly. The Crusaders are a brotherhood of Hospitallers almost as old as the Order itself. Their ranks are swelled by faithful from all walks of life, because the armor, weapons and training are paid for from the deep coffers of the Order of Junil. Therefore the Crusaders consist of only the best warriors, priests and surgeons, regardless of whence they came. Some elite Crusaders may go on to become noble Paladins of the Order. Their bothers train to replace them when they fall in righteous combat.

TEXT.English: 用来对抗恶魔单位。对恶魔有作战加成，对疾病免疫，能够消除区块上混沌之灰烬的尸妖散播的瘟疫。
TEXT.Chinese: 用来对抗恶魔单位。对恶魔有作战加成，对疾病免疫，能够消除区块上混沌之灰烬的尸妖散播的瘟疫。

TEXT.English: Death Knight - 死亡骑士[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 死亡骑士是对他们生前的莫大讽刺。骑士闪亮的盔甲散发着无比的荣耀，圣洁的旗帜指引他们前行，他们忠肝义胆，在战场上没有一丝畏惧。死亡骑士所经之地只留下遍地的尸体和致命的疾病，他们毫无怜悯地残杀无辜。有人说死亡骑士是那些背弃了忠诚誓约的骑士的灵魂变来的，但许多骑士私下认为恶魔有种方法能够把最高贵的灵魂拖入地狱为其效力。这种由恐惧激发的虔诚是仅凭国家法令所无法到达的，几乎所有骑士都向经过身边的祭司祈求祝福。

TEXT.English: Ecclesiastic - 天空使者[PARAGRAPH:2]I was invited to attend the initiation rites of the Ecclesiastics in Balderham. Ordinarily I would have feared some attempt at propaganda or persuasion, but in all things the Empyrean is open. The Vicar and one Ecclesiastic walked from the temple, at the heart of the city, while I followed behind a respectful distance, a welcome observer but not participant. We went not to the manor house of the local lord, nor the poor beggars in their slums, nor to some sacred altar from which to pray. The Vicar led us to the dungeon, and the Ecclesiastic aspirant showed the same surprised a felt.[PARAGRAPH:1]The guards let us pass, and downwards we walked, through the squalor that inevitably collected in such a place, even a relatively enlightened realm such as this. Men moved forward to watch us as we passed. Some hurled taunts or mockery, while some hurled more vile substances, the excrement occasionally landing on the vicars robes. [PARAGRAPH:1]The young man flinched, though his mentor did not. "Why have we come to such a dark place, Father?" asked the Ecclesiastic. "Why do we go anywhere?" was the reply. "To bring light into the darkness." This was some sort of code or mantra, for they both spoke it together. They stopped at one cell, a ragged man shuffled up to the bars, blinking in the light of our torch. "This is the darkest corner of our realm, dear child, not for the fact that we descend deep into this hole, but for the depravity of those who were brought here. This man has... his hands are stained with the blood of man. But he has requested to hear of the light. If you can bring him from the darkness, you will be ready for your vows. Lugus will show you the way." The Vicar passed the torch to his charge, and turned to leave. The man behind the bars sank to his knees and cried, "Teach me, lord, please!"[PARAGRAPH:1]The boy knelt to pray for wisdom, and I turned to leave as well, though I caught the eye to the imprisoned man and grew to doubt success of the young man's mission in this place.[PARAGRAPH:2]From chapter 3 of Reflections on the State Cults, by Elder Methyl of the Luonnatar.
TEXT.Chinese: Ecclesiastic - 天空使者[PARAGRAPH:2]I was invited to attend the initiation rites of the Ecclesiastics in Balderham. Ordinarily I would have feared some attempt at propaganda or persuasion, but in all things the Empyrean is open. The Vicar and one Ecclesiastic walked from the temple, at the heart of the city, while I followed behind a respectful distance, a welcome observer but not participant. We went not to the manor house of the local lord, nor the poor beggars in their slums, nor to some sacred altar from which to pray. The Vicar led us to the dungeon, and the Ecclesiastic aspirant showed the same surprised a felt.[PARAGRAPH:1]The guards let us pass, and downwards we walked, through the squalor that inevitably collected in such a place, even a relatively enlightened realm such as this. Men moved forward to watch us as we passed. Some hurled taunts or mockery, while some hurled more vile substances, the excrement occasionally landing on the vicars robes. [PARAGRAPH:1]The young man flinched, though his mentor did not. "Why have we come to such a dark place, Father?" asked the Ecclesiastic. "Why do we go anywhere?" was the reply. "To bring light into the darkness." This was some sort of code or mantra, for they both spoke it together. They stopped at one cell, a ragged man shuffled up to the bars, blinking in the light of our torch. "This is the darkest corner of our realm, dear child, not for the fact that we descend deep into this hole, but for the depravity of those who were brought here. This man has... his hands are stained with the blood of man. But he has requested to hear of the light. If you can bring him from the darkness, you will be ready for your vows. Lugus will show you the way." The Vicar passed the torch to his charge, and turned to leave. The man behind the bars sank to his knees and cried, "Teach me, lord, please!"[PARAGRAPH:1]The boy knelt to pray for wisdom, and I turned to leave as well, though I caught the eye to the imprisoned man and grew to doubt success of the young man's mission in this place.[PARAGRAPH:2]From chapter 3 of Reflections on the State Cults, by Elder Methyl of the Luonnatar.

TEXT.English: Disciple of Leaves - 绿叶使者[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 德鲁依为弟子簇拥，仿佛橡树矗立林中。众人身边环绕玫瑰，花儿已得圣水滋润。凝神观察身边林丛，一只老狼将要寿终。探索自然数月之久，弟子倾注关怀其中。老狼将遭幼豹戏耍，弟子眼中流露忧愁。护狼驱豹并非善举，大师斥责门徒之忧。弟子内心忿忿难平，人人为其抱怨不公。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “吾等不能妄断自然，只可将它观察研究。自然不愿接受弱者，吾等不可将其袒护。世间生命皆是平等，万物生存都具自由。生命不比死亡可贵，事物轮回皆有始终。尔等本分仅在详述，职责不为生命护佑。种子生根发芽枯萎，然后重归生命之中。”课已授毕，德鲁依率门徒穿越森林，众树木为长者让出道路。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] ——摘自《国祭的思考》第五章 天母审判官爱迪尔·梅斯

TEXT.English: Zealot - 深渊使者[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 我无从得知狂热祭司是如何挑选深渊使者的。他们有时是流浪汉，有时是贵族子弟，似乎每个人都有被选中的资格。在月圆之夜，他将遭到诱拐，并被绑住手脚送入神庙。为了让他安定下来，一些教派利用多种药草调合的试剂令他窒息从而丧失意识。人们将他抬至一个浅洼，使他的身体部分浸泡在海水之中。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 祭司们整晚都会聚集在他身边，倾听他睡梦中的呓语。而这些只言片语将成为他新的名字，然后名字会被刻在盛满海水的陶罐上。我曾经见过其中一些，一个是“沉眠海怪的颤抖”，另一个是“奴隶之血倾入冥河”。受害者整晚都毫无知觉地酣睡着。照这样下去，他非淹死不可，并成为效忠于深渊霸主的亡灵军团中的一员。幸运地，抑或是不幸地，他最终发出了一声呐喊：“神在注视着我！”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 祭司们相互点了点头，将他从水中拉出来。当他看见那些抓住他的人，便恐惧得蜷缩成了一团。祭司并没有向他言语什么，而是把他带进后殿。我无法再跟随进去，也不知道里面发生了什么。但几天后我看见他身着海蓝色的长袍，眼中充满血丝，不断地自言自语，在小镇集市上拥挤的人群中徘徊着。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] ——摘自《国祭的思考》第七章 天母审判官爱迪尔·梅斯

TEXT.English: Thane of Kilmorph - 大地使者[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 年老的守护祭司被一阵突来的敲门声惊醒。他睁开朦胧的双眼，推开门，惊讶地发现门前站着一位少年。“孩子，祷告要等到晚上。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 男孩鼓足了勇气。“先生，我想成为一名大地使者。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 守护祭司脸上带着微笑，看着这位执着的来访者，回想起自己很久以前说过的同样的话语。“铁匠清晨何时起床点燃自己的熔炉？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “嗯？我不知道，我并不想当个铁匠，我要侍奉基鲁莫夫！”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “商人怎样才能让骆驼的步调一致？国王如何裁决对人们的判罚？采矿者如何知晓哪里能掘出矿石？厨师怎样避免面包烤焦？士兵在战前如何保持自己的勇气？”男孩目瞪口呆地看着守护祭司，老人微微一笑，“年轻人，基鲁莫夫并不在人们侍奉的庙宇中，而是与她的子民同在。她与铁匠一同工作，了解他的努力和梦想；她与商人一道旅行，指引他走出危险的诱惑；当士兵们英勇献身，当国王下令处死罪犯，她将与士兵国王同在。[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]基鲁莫夫[COLOR_REVERT]将我们凝聚在一起，就好比陶匠用泥土制作陶器。只有当人们将你视作他们中的一份子，他们才会倾听你的意见。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “那我什么时候才能拥有资格呢？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “到时你自然便会知道。基鲁莫夫将指引你再次回到这里，我将向你传授如何掌握她的伟力。守护祭司拥有移山填海的力量，而这力量必须依靠于众人的信仰。去吧，将人们凝聚一心，使他们对神虔信；当你再度来此，大地将听从你的号令。”老人犹豫地看着和自己所剩不多的时间后慢慢地走回去，继续他的午睡。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] ——摘自《国祭的思考》第七章 天母审判官爱迪尔·梅斯

TEXT.English: 所有的圣职单位都有共同的2个特点，一是他们都自带[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]医疗[COLOR_REVERT]晋升，二是他们都可以传播宗教。
TEXT.Chinese: 所有的圣职单位都有共同的2个特点，一是他们都自带[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]医疗[COLOR_REVERT]晋升，二是他们都可以传播宗教。

TEXT.English: Savant - 灰烬使者[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 他悄悄环顾四周，走向阴影中的法阵祭司。他所去的并非一座拥有友善的僧侣和理性的辩论的神庙，而是一座被封印的遗迹。这个戴着头罩的青年推开门，迳直走了进去。里面只有蜡烛照明，它们投射出异样的光芒。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 忽然一只粗糙的手像铁钳一样紧紧地攥住了他的右腕。他下意识地挣扎着，但其他法阵祭司牢牢抓住他的肩膀和左臂。“你为什么来这？”攥住他手腕的法阵祭司说话时发出嘶嘶的声响。其他人则静静地看着他。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “你告诉过我，在这里我可以成为你们中的一员。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “不对。那是你自己的想法。你为什么来这？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 学者再一次答道：“我是来交易的。用我自己。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 法阵祭司点点头，拿出一把刀，深深地砍入这位新来者的掌中。看着喷涌而出的血液渐渐变成细流，在掌心聚成血泊，法阵祭司把散发着芳香的药剂到入血中，然后放开了他。学者赶紧捂住自己的伤口止血。所有法阵祭司都举起蜡烛，点燃了一种带着血腥味的药剂。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 伴随着一阵强烈的恶臭，一小团火焰出现了。“你想得到什么？”低沉的声音回荡在房内。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 学者凝视着火苗，开口说道：“我被人冷落、虐待、凌辱。我要力量！我要复仇！”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “你用什么交换？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “我的一切！生命、健康、家庭、还有灵魂！”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “成交！我很满意，你把自己当作了回报。让我们欢迎新的追随者！”声音消失了。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 法阵祭司又一次抓住学者的手，并将手掌送进了那团火焰。火焰并没有灼伤他，然而，他开始慢慢变老，皮肤也出现了皱纹。皱纹沿着他的手臂扩散开来，随即布满了全身。然后他被放开了，瘫到在地上。他呆在那一动不动有好几分钟，我似乎听到了他在啜泣。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 然而，他是在笑，他的眼中燃烧着黑暗之火。我最后所听到的是，“我感觉到了……力量！最终……”当他被剥去外衣，套上学者的长袍时依然在放声大笑。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] ——摘自《国祭的思考》第九章 天母审判官爱迪尔·梅斯
TEXT.Chinese: Savant - 灰烬使者[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 他悄悄环顾四周，走向阴影中的法阵祭司。他所去的并非一座拥有友善的僧侣和理性的辩论的神庙，而是一座被封印的遗迹。这个戴着头罩的青年推开门，迳直走了进去。里面只有蜡烛照明，它们投射出异样的光芒。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 忽然一只粗糙的手像铁钳一样紧紧地攥住了他的右腕。他下意识地挣扎着，但其他法阵祭司牢牢抓住他的肩膀和左臂。“你为什么来这？”攥住他手腕的法阵祭司说话时发出嘶嘶的声响。其他人则静静地看着他。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “你告诉过我，在这里我可以成为你们中的一员。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “不对。那是你自己的想法。你为什么来这？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 学者再一次答道：“我是来交易的。用我自己。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 法阵祭司点点头，拿出一把刀，深深地砍入这位新来者的掌中。看着喷涌而出的血液渐渐变成细流，在掌心聚成血泊，法阵祭司把散发着芳香的药剂到入血中，然后放开了他。学者赶紧捂住自己的伤口止血。所有法阵祭司都举起蜡烛，点燃了一种带着血腥味的药剂。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 伴随着一阵强烈的恶臭，一小团火焰出现了。“你想得到什么？”低沉的声音回荡在房内。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 学者凝视着火苗，开口说道：“我被人冷落、虐待、凌辱。我要力量！我要复仇！”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “你用什么交换？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “我的一切！生命、健康、家庭、还有灵魂！”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “成交！我很满意，你把自己当作了回报。让我们欢迎新的追随者！”声音消失了。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 法阵祭司又一次抓住学者的手，并将手掌送进了那团火焰。火焰并没有灼伤他，然而，他开始慢慢变老，皮肤也出现了皱纹。皱纹沿着他的手臂扩散开来，随即布满了全身。然后他被放开了，瘫到在地上。他呆在那一动不动有好几分钟，我似乎听到了他在啜泣。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 然而，他是在笑，他的眼中燃烧着黑暗之火。我最后所听到的是，“我感觉到了……力量！最终……”当他被剥去外衣，套上学者的长袍时依然在放声大笑。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] ——摘自《国祭的思考》第九章 天母审判官爱迪尔·梅斯

TEXT.English: Acolyte - 秩序使者[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 笃诚的助祭者被带到教堂或神殿的屋子，与忏悔祭司相伴。这是一个助祭者没有经历过的仪式，同时也是一个考验。他们的脚下是城市，这里有众多的居住者。商人，军人，农民，工人，贵族，每个人都有自己的工作。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “看看外面，我的孩子。”忏悔祭司在诱导，“告诉我你可以看到什么。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “绝对秩序。”年轻的助祭者答道。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 忏悔祭司笑了。“你是怎么看到绝对秩序的？每个人都有自己的意愿。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “绝对秩序是由法典规定。正如我们遵从神旨法典，我们可以和其他人合作，获得绝对秩序的最终表达形式，文明。每个人的工作就是为伟大的事业献出一切而不必知道详情，即使是那些满怀恶意的人也不得不屈从于法典。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “什么是神旨法典信徒面临的最大诱惑？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “怜悯。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “为什么？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “仁慈的孩子是喜欢救赎和不公的。对杀人犯的宽恕就是对死者的侮辱，对小偷的同情就是对受害人的不公。对敌人的宽恕是最大的功德，但是不经思考的宽恕只会带来将来的痛苦。那些愿意宽恕一切的人是在参与一场赌博；结果就是他的失败和在社会上埋下祸根。做出怜悯需要上帝般的判断力。”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “那什么是你最大的优点？”[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] “服从。毫不犹豫的服从。”考验结束了，助祭者会沐浴和接受祝福，成为绝对秩序的一员。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] ——摘自《国祭的思考》第二章 天母审判官爱迪尔·梅斯。

TEXT.English: Diseased Corpses - 尸妖[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 混沌之灰烬的特殊单位。面对门口徘徊着携带疾病单位的坚固城市，没有人会不害怕。他们是唯一开始就具有疾病晋升的单位，可以使疾病在战场上大规模传播。生产尸妖不需要指定建筑和资源，只有在信奉混沌之灰烬并且是国教的城市才能生产。
TEXT.Chinese: Diseased Corpses - 尸妖[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 混沌之灰烬的特殊单位。面对门口徘徊着携带疾病单位的坚固城市，没有人会不害怕。他们是唯一开始就具有疾病晋升的单位，可以使疾病在战场上大规模传播。生产尸妖不需要指定建筑和资源，只有在信奉混沌之灰烬并且是国教的城市才能生产。

TEXT.English: 使用他们向敌人单位传播疾病吧。
TEXT.Chinese: 使用他们向敌人单位传播疾病吧。

TEXT.English: Divided Soul - 裂灵[PARAGRAPH:2]Verdian moved slowly through the camp. The falling snow gave more notice to the alert soldiers on the perimeter than he did, but he moved slowly anyway. He could be perceived by some alert or spiritually attuned individuals if he were careless, so he stayed out of the moonlight and followed the winds. The winds were stronger than he had expected at this time, even at the foothills of Tempus Mor. The snowfall was unseasonal as well, and he used that to his advantage, getting ever closer to the center of the camp without drawing notice.[PARAGRAPH:1]The guards at the large tent were less alert, but more experienced. One man was warming himself by a large fire as Verdian passed, and his form was outlined in the smoke. The guard drew his scimitar and stepped back into the doorway of the tent, alert now though he couldn't guess for what. Verdian took a risk and pushed past him. The guardsman felt the heat of the fire give way to a chill, but the tent was sturdy and should have blocked the wind. While a false alarm may bring some menial punishment and minor humiliation upon him, ignoring an intruder here could bring his death. He called out, "Lord Commander Decius! Awaken, I fear some magic about us." Decius stirred from his rest on the floor of the tent, and other sentries rushed in.[PARAGRAPH:1]Emotion was tempered in Verdian, like his kin, and even more so when so far from his slowly beating heart. He felt neither irritation nor fear when he heard the sentry's call, but pushed himself to action. Sidar Divided Souls would usually will their somnolent bodies to reunite with their spirits slowly, and all at once. This was more for their comfort than from necessity, however. Verdian's hands appeared in the air above Decius' chest, clasped together and holding a slim stiletto. Even as the muscle and sinew of his arms and shoulders followed he forced it to begin a downward descent, despite the pain this would cause him as the rest of his body took shape.[PARAGRAPH:1]The sentries were stunned for a critical moment by this spectacle, gasping in awe but unable to reach the killer in time. Decius had been forged in far more battles than the desert warriors he now led, and had seen and slain far more frightening apparitions. He rolled out of the way, saving his heart from the blade. Verdian pierced his upper arm and hopped back, drawing another blade. His form was now complete, and though his body complained of this painful transition, his will was stronger.[PARAGRAPH:1]Decius reached for his blade, or tried to. His arm was numb, and not from pain. If the poison coating the stiletto had reached his heart, instead... He pulled the attacker's weapon out with his left hand and prepared to parry. He didn't have to, for by now his men were surrounding him. Decius finally got a chance to get a better look at Verdian, but the garb that obscured showed only that he was a human man. "You aren't the one I expected," he said.[PARAGRAPH:1]Verdian needed but a moment to concentrate, to separate. His soul would be unable to be bound by strong arms, and if he could get beyond the bounds of the camp he could pull his body back to him. Sandalphon would need to know he had failed his task. Rathus and the others would hopefully fare better against their targets. He closed his eyes, pushed away from his body... but was drawn back with a cry.[PARAGRAPH:1]Decius held a torch against the hunter's body. "I'm afraid we need to have a chat before you leave. Who are you and why did you try to kill me?"

TEXT.English: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]裂灵[COLOR_REVERT]可以将他们的灵魂从身体中分离出来并在不被人发现的情况下攻击或侦查。如果分裂出来的灵魂处在一个[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]裂灵[COLOR_REVERT]可以进入的土地上，那么它可以将[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]裂灵[COLOR_REVERT]召唤来。
TEXT.Chinese: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]裂灵[COLOR_REVERT]可以将他们的灵魂从身体中分离出来并在不被人发现的情况下攻击或侦查。如果分裂出来的灵魂处在一个[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]裂灵[COLOR_REVERT]可以进入的土地上，那么它可以将[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]裂灵[COLOR_REVERT]召唤来。

TEXT.English: Djinn - 灯神[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 灯神是水的精灵，尤其受沙漠居民的崇拜。它们由盘旋的薄雾形成，通常有人的形状和大小，并因喜好藏在瓶子或灯盏中捉弄旅人而着称。尽管轻灵的特性使得它们可以随意获取能量，但很多灯神并不会费心去练习魔法。在主人需要它们的能力时，它们在执行命令前常常会要求主人解答迷题。许多召唤者都曾研究过如何避免灯神的这个怪僻，不过更明智的人则乐在其中。
TEXT.Chinese: Djinn - 灯神[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 灯神是水的精灵，尤其受沙漠居民的崇拜。它们由盘旋的薄雾形成，通常有人的形状和大小，并因喜好藏在瓶子或灯盏中捉弄旅人而着称。尽管轻灵的特性使得它们可以随意获取能量，但很多灯神并不会费心去练习魔法。在主人需要它们的能力时，它们在执行命令前常常会要求主人解答迷题。许多召唤者都曾研究过如何避免灯神的这个怪僻，不过更明智的人则乐在其中。

TEXT.English: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]灯神[COLOR_REVERT]对全元素都有亲和性，因此当你控制多个资源时，它将十分强大。
TEXT.Chinese: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]灯神[COLOR_REVERT]对全元素都有亲和性，因此当你控制多个资源时，它将十分强大。

TEXT.English: 卢乌是班诺尔的英雄，一位传奇的恶魔与不死者屠戮者。他能在城市中招募单位，且与大指挥官不同，招募并不会牺牲他自身。倘若卢乌证实传说不虚，斩杀恶魔与不死者，他便会重获招募之能，若能在自己的一场场战斗中幸存下来，还可组建起一支庞大的军队。[PARAGRAPH:2]那头追踪他的猎犬起初几乎看似正常，直到它转过身、发出低吼。半张脸已然腐烂，底下的头骨伤痕累累、缺了几块，一个眼窝是黑黢黢的一洞。可它看猎物却毫无障碍。它朝卢乌的喉咙扑去。[PARAGRAPH:1]这远非卢乌见过的第一头地狱犬。反射本能接管了一切，他俯身翻滚，避开了獠牙。他那简陋的武器飞入手中。卢乌与那猎犬相互绕行，佯攻又退回，直到电光石火间一切告终。卢乌闪过那一扑，把刀刃没入这恶魔的脖颈，将它钉在地上。它低吼着，近乎滑稽地翻腾挣扎，想要脱身、继续攻击。[PARAGRAPH:1]“来吧，乖仔，装死，”卢乌说着，把盾牌狠狠砸在那猎犬的头骨上。二者一齐碎裂，翻腾也停了。“真是条好狗。”[PARAGRAPH:1]他不再为自己的俏皮话发笑了。他早在许久之前就不再自寻乐子。十年还是一千年，他毫无概念，也早已不再在意。自他的族人离开地狱，便再没有别人可以发笑了，可他仍在冷峻地与这一界的居民搏杀时插科打诨。在绝望之王的居所里，他最大的战斗，是维系那唯一支撑着他的东西——希望。[PARAGRAPH:2]“我们没有希望了，凯布瑞尔。我们必须放弃围城。”[PARAGRAPH:1]凯布瑞尔转身面向她的外甥。“我们不能，马提乌斯！你听见我从法纳里尔口中听到的话了。‘塞安人取得了突破。有阿加雷斯的指引。’我们必须挺进！”凯布瑞尔说话时颤抖着，她那衰老的身躯近来愈发不听使唤了。倘若她召见麾下议事时不披全副战甲，或许会稳当些，可身为班诺尔的战争领袖，却不时刻备战？[PARAGRAPH:1]“我们的确必须。”大祭司附和道。他很年轻，比他所奏对的这位摄政年轻得多，说起话来却带着无上的自信。“源自加尔维霍姆的种种异端，已足以构成动员的挑衅。因此萨巴曦尔认为我们连与法纳里尔这样的精灵匪徒结交都毫无理由。”[PARAGRAPH:1]马提乌斯嗤之以鼻。“我敢说萨巴曦尔知道把一名探子送入塞安领地的更好办法，可他近来一直不怎么肯明说。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“维内拉特家的家主莫非在质疑祭司团代言的权威……”[PARAGRAPH:1]“艾敏，马提乌斯要指出的是，”凯布瑞尔插话道，“我们需要为我们的任务排定轻重。余灰部落一直在积蓄力量，我们的使节被逐出了拉努恩首都，还有——”[PARAGRAPH:1]战争议事会被一阵剧烈的地震打断，把众人尽数掀翻在地。凯布瑞尔的反射本能战胜了年迈的局限；她一跃而起，冲出帐篷。营地展现出班诺尔纪律的成效，已在指挥官帐篷四周列好阵形，随时准备击退来袭。[PARAGRAPH:1]可这并非一场攻击开场的魔法齐射。全军眼睁睁看着他们下方山坡上的树木与灌丛枯萎死去，太阳被一层阴沉的霾遮蔽，地平线上火焰迸发。这是凯布瑞尔从孩提时代、并在此后无数噩梦中都记忆犹新的一幕。七十年前他们逃离了地狱，如今地狱却找上门来了。[PARAGRAPH:2]他曾走遍这座地狱，寻找一处出口。且不论它是一片无限的界域，他敢发誓自己每一寸都看过两遍了。他一路上被阿加雷斯与巴尔的爪牙追杀，好歹或是甩脱、或是击退了它们。只为得见今日。[PARAGRAPH:1]卢乌看见下方山谷里延展开一道通往凡间的传送门。一道维度的裂隙，剧烈地波动着。而它周围列布着一支恶魔大军。上蹿下跳的小恶魔、一队鲁宾、一整座恶灵之城……还有卢乌所见过最庞大的巨角炎魔。而它们正在离去。“哦，休想撇下我，你们别想，”他喃喃道，动身下了山坡。“我不知道你们要去哪儿，可那总该好过这里。”[PARAGRAPH:1]恶魔们列队穿过，那裂隙则缓缓开始闭合。[PARAGRAPH:2]恶魔们踏上了征途。与它们的第一战令班诺尔大军溃散，自那以后他们被逼退到了托尔莱汉，那是离受污之地最近的定居点。从它的城垛上，凯布瑞尔整夜都能看见与地狱军团接壤处的火焰。至此，祭司们的祝福挡住了污秽，却挡不住那些受污者。它们围住了定居点，那些曾在她年少时缠扰她的恶魔。唯有最勇敢的士兵留下来与它们对峙。[PARAGRAPH:1]战斗在破晓时打响。它很快便对他们不利起来。[PARAGRAPH:1]马提乌斯与他的姨母并肩立于战线上。“我若注定要死，能死在传说中的英雄之一身旁，我倍感荣幸。”[PARAGRAPH:1]凯布瑞尔点点头，挥舞着她的双手巨剑。“我倒宁愿活着。可倘若班诺尔人不挺身面对这可怖的威胁，还有谁会呢？”视野边缘的一个身影令她转过身，与一头狰狞的嗜血兽撞了个正着。[PARAGRAPH:1]“对付这些畜生的诀窍是从背后下手，”一位老友高喊着，那嗜血兽应声倒地。“翅膀限制了它们的余光视野。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“是谁……我的天，是你吗？神子卢乌？”[PARAGRAPH:1]“如假包换，难得地以血肉之躯现身。”[PARAGRAPH:1]马提乌斯倒抽一口气。“那么那些传说……全是真的？我们是萨巴曦尔的班诺尔人！”[PARAGRAPH:1]战局逆转了。班诺尔人阵亡的与幸存的一样多，可城镇得救了，地狱的军队今日被击退了。捷报传开，令那些逃走的人蒙羞，也激励了新的一代。这正是萨巴曦尔一直保全他们以待的那场战争，而它才刚刚开始。可第一场胜利，属于他们。

TEXT.English: 这个班诺尔联邦的英雄具有[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]募兵[COLOR_REVERT]能力，每当他杀死一个恶魔或不死单位时，他就可以再度获得这个能力。而他自己的装备，可以给予他防御加成。
TEXT.Chinese: 这个班诺尔联邦的英雄具有[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]募兵[COLOR_REVERT]能力，每当他杀死一个恶魔或不死单位时，他就可以再度获得这个能力。而他自己的装备，可以给予他防御加成。

TEXT.English: Dragon Slayer - 屠龙武士[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 卡西尔自力更生的理念和授予凡人的权力远远多于空谈。战士们总是毫无畏惧的走上战场，为国家而献身的精神丝毫不逊色于十字军对神明的忠诚。如果一条懒龙想要依赖龙族的威名来保全自己，屠龙武士会乐于把财宝运回家乡。
TEXT.Chinese: Dragon Slayer - 屠龙武士[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 卡西尔自力更生的理念和授予凡人的权力远远多于空谈。战士们总是毫无畏惧的走上战场，为国家而献身的精神丝毫不逊色于十字军对神明的忠诚。如果一条懒龙想要依赖龙族的威名来保全自己，屠龙武士会乐于把财宝运回家乡。

TEXT.English: 不要被屠龙武士的名字所迷惑。他面对人类单位时同样出色，他们的勇气晋升减轻了施法者的负担。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]译注：每个屠龙武士都可以无条件使用希柔娜的拥抱。
TEXT.Chinese: 不要被屠龙武士的名字所迷惑。他面对人类单位时同样出色，他们的勇气晋升减轻了施法者的负担。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]译注：每个屠龙武士都可以无条件使用希柔娜的拥抱。

TEXT.English: Drifa the White Dragon - 白龙德瑞法[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] An axe, a plow, a hammer. Tools are the marker of the pinnacle races, clearly distinguishing them from the animals that shared this world alongside them. From their beginning, the most important of these tools were weapons, utilized for protection and conquest.[PARAGRAPH:1]As man built, so built the gods. The weapon of the gods is not a sword or spear, however. It is the beast, created monsters sent against each other, or against the armies of their rivals. The most frightening of these beasts were the dragons.[PARAGRAPH:1]Drifa is Mularn's ultimate weapon, banished with the signing of the compact but now stomping across Erebus again, a blizzard of fangs, wings, and frozen death.
TEXT.Chinese: Drifa the White Dragon - 白龙德瑞法[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] An axe, a plow, a hammer. Tools are the marker of the pinnacle races, clearly distinguishing them from the animals that shared this world alongside them. From their beginning, the most important of these tools were weapons, utilized for protection and conquest.[PARAGRAPH:1]As man built, so built the gods. The weapon of the gods is not a sword or spear, however. It is the beast, created monsters sent against each other, or against the armies of their rivals. The most frightening of these beasts were the dragons.[PARAGRAPH:1]Drifa is Mularn's ultimate weapon, banished with the signing of the compact but now stomping across Erebus again, a blizzard of fangs, wings, and frozen death.

TEXT.English: Drown - 水鬼[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 灯光摇曳多么古怪，[NEWLINE] 此景皆因水波荡漾，[NEWLINE] 我是如此由衷渴求，[NEWLINE] 时时刻刻向上凝望；[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 悬浮洞中我把身藏，[NEWLINE] 呼吸顺畅不受影响，[NEWLINE] 自那之后我非人类，[NEWLINE] 冰冷水流将我埋葬；[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 安宁之地为我向往，[NEWLINE] 竖耳聆听远处异样，[NEWLINE] 没顶之魂放声呼喊，[NEWLINE] 心爱之人甚感悲伤；[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 哀声怨语传遍河浜，[NEWLINE] 身形躯壳不同寻常，[NEWLINE] 昏沉步向无名之地，[NEWLINE] 那儿新生伴随死亡；[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 但是生命依然坚强，[NEWLINE] 生者未曾将他遗忘，[NEWLINE] 火热激情言词在耳，[NEWLINE] 日夜独忆甜蜜已往；[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 这里通向冰冷海洋，[NEWLINE] 我的心头不再忧伤，[NEWLINE] 曾经深深爱恋之人，[NEWLINE] 尚在世间生活如常；[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 但愿一切皆为虚幻，[NEWLINE] 无法忍受日思夜想，[NEWLINE] 阴森海底把我囚禁，[NEWLINE] 未曾将你身影遗忘；[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 祈求得到你的原谅，[NEWLINE] 寂静世界独自前往，[NEWLINE] 留你一人黯然神伤，[NEWLINE] 残酷甚于奔赴死亡。

TEXT.English: 深渊霸主的特殊单位，也是早期的不死单位。和斧兵一样强大又可以在海滨移动。作为不死单位对疾病免疫，对抗尸妖特别有效。
TEXT.Chinese: 深渊霸主的特殊单位，也是早期的不死单位。和斧兵一样强大又可以在海滨移动。作为不死单位对疾病免疫，对抗尸妖特别有效。

TEXT.English: Druid - 德鲁伊[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 受到苏赛鲁斯魔法的影响，获得了新生，德鲁伊是自然的魔法师，他们带来生命的活力。获得真理、延续如何操纵生命的本真构造的唯一途径是将自己身心全部的投入自然的怀抱。德鲁伊们都是隐居的，并不结成社交团体。德鲁伊们建立起一种不太紧密的手足之情，他们每年聚会一次，相互比较、分享、凝聚知识，随后重归他们所属的田野和森林。他们拥有强力的自然魔法，多数帝国并非为了战争雇佣他们，而是为了和平；他们能使国土更加肥沃。少数特定国家无法招募德鲁伊用以治愈战火的创伤或是为贫瘠的大地带来生机。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 只有阵营为[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]中立[COLOR_REVERT]玩家才能生产德鲁伊。
TEXT.Chinese: Druid - 德鲁伊[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 受到苏赛鲁斯魔法的影响，获得了新生，德鲁伊是自然的魔法师，他们带来生命的活力。获得真理、延续如何操纵生命的本真构造的唯一途径是将自己身心全部的投入自然的怀抱。德鲁伊们都是隐居的，并不结成社交团体。德鲁伊们建立起一种不太紧密的手足之情，他们每年聚会一次，相互比较、分享、凝聚知识，随后重归他们所属的田野和森林。他们拥有强力的自然魔法，多数帝国并非为了战争雇佣他们，而是为了和平；他们能使国土更加肥沃。少数特定国家无法招募德鲁伊用以治愈战火的创伤或是为贫瘠的大地带来生机。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 只有阵营为[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]中立[COLOR_REVERT]玩家才能生产德鲁伊。

TEXT.English: 德鲁伊是唯一具有医疗Ⅰ晋升的中立神职单位。是一个高力量的使用法术单位，可以升级所有的自然魔法。
TEXT.Chinese: 德鲁伊是唯一具有医疗Ⅰ晋升的中立神职单位。是一个高力量的使用法术单位，可以升级所有的自然魔法。

TEXT.English: Baron Duin Halfmorn - 狼人杜因·哈夫蒙[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 杜因是[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]魔法时代[COLOR_REVERT]令人恐惧的好战者。每当胜利后，他和部下们会在敌人的尸体上举办奢华的宴会。部下的野心不断膨胀，最后爆发了血腥的内战。杜因赢得了战争却失去了他的帝国；最终，他只能孤单一人在部下的尸体上举办宴会。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 如同所有凡人，即便是凶残的杜因也会死去，但他并不能得到永久的安眠。在可怕的欲望驱使下，不顾一切的魔法师举行仪式将这个史上最强大，最可怕的统帅重新唤回了世间。但这并非没有代价：众神知晓杜因的脾性，不会让他以一个不适当的形态复生。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 自[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]冰河时代[COLOR_REVERT]起，狼人便已销声匿迹。没有堪比吸血鬼的智商，它们被幸存的人类消灭殆尽。但是由于杜因·哈夫蒙，这些邪恶的造物将会见证一次恐怖的重生，自由的人们会在恐惧中颤抖。

TEXT.English: 杜因由于未知的原因在大陆上复活，受到了狼狂的诅咒：被他杀死的有生命单位会变成跟随他的饥渴狼人。
TEXT.Chinese: 杜因由于未知的原因在大陆上复活，受到了狼狂的诅咒：被他杀死的有生命单位会变成跟随他的饥渴狼人。

TEXT.English: 卡扎德王国拥有全游戏最强大的[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]加农炮[COLOR_REVERT]单位，可以快速摧毁敌军防御。
TEXT.Chinese: 卡扎德王国拥有全游戏最强大的[COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]加农炮[COLOR_REVERT]单位，可以快速摧毁敌军防御。

TEXT.English: 矮人德鲁依不太适合控制自然生态系统，可以操纵大地魔法。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 译注：只有矮人德鲁伊可以施放碾压
TEXT.Chinese: 矮人德鲁依不太适合控制自然生态系统，可以操纵大地魔法。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 译注：只有矮人德鲁伊可以施放碾压

TEXT.English: 一只发疯的犀牛，上面骑着一个喝醉的矮人，还有什么比这更可怕的？
TEXT.Chinese: 一只发疯的犀牛，上面骑着一个喝醉的矮人，还有什么比这更可怕的？

TEXT.English: Earth Elemental - 地元素[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 一个强大但是缓慢的单位。召唤者最好对目标近距离施法，但地元素在攻击方面是强大的。更有利的是，召唤者下一回合可以召唤一个新的地元素。
TEXT.Chinese: Earth Elemental - 地元素[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 一个强大但是缓慢的单位。召唤者最好对目标近距离施法，但地元素在攻击方面是强大的。更有利的是，召唤者下一回合可以召唤一个新的地元素。

TEXT.English: Eater of Dreams - 噬梦者[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 噬梦者可以通过减少城市人口用以重获“灵魂毁灭”技能。这使他成为一个强大的城市防守者。在城市大到可以献上足够的牺牲品时还可以召唤大量的巨角炎魔和火元素。
TEXT.Chinese: Eater of Dreams - 噬梦者[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 噬梦者可以通过减少城市人口用以重获“灵魂毁灭”技能。这使他成为一个强大的城市防守者。在城市大到可以献上足够的牺牲品时还可以召唤大量的巨角炎魔和火元素。

TEXT.English: 因这里，孤然独处，居着一位——其手曾造出[NEWLINE]令世间因惧而战栗的怪异幻影；[NEWLINE]其镌于恐怖典籍中的符文曾昭示[NEWLINE]星渊之外潜伏窥伺的种种存在。[NEWLINE]阿维洛涅的暗黑之主——其窗棂凝望着[NEWLINE]无人目光所能承受的梦之深坑！[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]幻影死灵不侍奉任何主人，却甘愿投身任何殊死的争斗。良善的宗教避这些恶魔造物唯恐不及，或索性搜寻并将其铲除，可那些容忍其邪恶存在的人，会发觉它们是无所畏惧、致命的战士，在任何战场上都几乎无可匹敌。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]唯有邪恶阵营的玩家才能建造幻影死灵。
TEXT.Chinese: 因这里，孤然独处，居着一位——其手曾造出[NEWLINE]令世间因惧而战栗的怪异幻影；[NEWLINE]其镌于恐怖典籍中的符文曾昭示[NEWLINE]星渊之外潜伏窥伺的种种存在。[NEWLINE]阿维洛涅的暗黑之主——其窗棂凝望着[NEWLINE]无人目光所能承受的梦之深坑！[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]幻影死灵不侍奉任何主人，却甘愿投身任何殊死的争斗。良善的宗教避这些恶魔造物唯恐不及，或索性搜寻并将其铲除，可那些容忍其邪恶存在的人，会发觉它们是无所畏惧、致命的战士，在任何战场上都几乎无可匹敌。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]唯有邪恶阵营的玩家才能建造幻影死灵。

TEXT.English: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]幻影死灵[COLOR_REVERT]只有阵营为[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]恶[COLOR_REVERT]的玩家才能生产幻影死灵。他们需要铁或者秘银作为资源。它们自带行军晋升。
TEXT.Chinese: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]幻影死灵[COLOR_REVERT]只有阵营为[COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]恶[COLOR_REVERT]的玩家才能生产幻影死灵。他们需要铁或者秘银作为资源。它们自带行军晋升。

TEXT.English: Host of the Einherjar - 英灵[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 在光荣的战斗中死去斗士的灵魂，渴望回到战场。死后不久他们的传说广为人知，英灵可以和任何敌人战斗，如果在战斗中获胜可以继续战斗，为他们的颂歌增加新的一章。
TEXT.Chinese: Host of the Einherjar - 英灵[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 在光荣的战斗中死去斗士的灵魂，渴望回到战场。死后不久他们的传说广为人知，英灵可以和任何敌人战斗，如果在战斗中获胜可以继续战斗，为他们的颂歌增加新的一章。

TEXT.English: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]英灵[COLOR_REVERT]每次战斗获胜后可以多存在一回合。
TEXT.Chinese: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]英灵[COLOR_REVERT]每次战斗获胜后可以多存在一回合。

TEXT.English: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]大象[COLOR_REVERT]不会主动进攻人，但是如果捉住并训练他们可以获得不错的攻击力。
TEXT.Chinese: [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]大象[COLOR_REVERT]不会主动进攻人，但是如果捉住并训练他们可以获得不错的攻击力。

TEXT.English: Eurabatres the Gold Dragon - 金龙尤拉巴崔斯[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 它仍然记得那些荣耀的日子，还有迅猛，利爪，酸液以及那坚韧的双翼。更难忘的是燃烧的火焰。即使没有鼻子可以去嗅闻，没有肌肤可以去感觉，但仍存留了对热量和烟火的感知。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 它的思绪躁动不安。显然众神已然对它和它的种族失去了兴趣了。仿佛是很久以前，仿佛是昨天，又可能是，明天。因为在这片土地上，时间和空间并无意义，仅有思想饱含深意。因为它明白，存在才是目的，而如智者所言：我思，故我在。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 在这片众神征战过的土地上，它并没有死去，而是遭到了封印。它的身体得到了安歇，但灵魂却无法安息。它仍然记得自己浑身散发夺目金光的模样，那曾经是这个世界上最强大的生物。它以火焰和酸液为武器，往来于各个位面，与不同位面的敌人战斗。现在，敌人依然还在，他们扰乱宁静，让它饱受刺痛，犹如暗室中持续的水滴敲击着心灵。的确，无法停止这种精神上的痛苦，它又如何能安息？[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 于是，当其他人都平静地歇息的时候，龙魂竭尽所能去找寻回到世界的那扇大门，希望完成它未尽的使命。最终，在无数次的尝试和失败后，它的灵魂得到了自由，来到了一个奇异的世界。然而惟有得到帮助才能复活形体。因此它的形体，则需等待。仪式祭起，筑起了大门。之后它需要征募力量，那些来自那些纷繁散乱，迷茫弱小而众多的生灵的力量，经历了被封印的时光之后，它又将成为这个世界的主宰。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 多少年来，龙魂一直希望在这平庸和懦弱的人海之中，寻找一个偶尔会闪现出夺目光芒的合适主人与可靠盟友、用来当作维持复活的必要材料。在那些材料之中，有些如风暴般凝重抑郁，有些如匕首般锐利冰冷，有些如薄雾般难以捉摸，有些则在光明中崭露头角，闪烁着光彩喧嚣，预示着成长的疯狂。已经有太多的材料因它敌人的诱惑而堕落了。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 所有的都没有这一个完美。它理智而具有魔力，并且璞玉可琢。龙魂接近它的时候，这缕光芒愈发清晰：这是一个在家园被烧毁的废墟中哭泣的孩子。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE] 他们的灵魂将为了共同的利益而融合。这样，一方获得了永生和力量，而另一方，则最终获得了形体。
